Google scholar, ProQuest databases are used to get relevant and proper journals related to topic.

articleTitle: Aggregation Techniques in Federated Learning: Comprehensive Survey, Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Federated learning is a new paradigm on the machine learning system that uses the traditional system of machine learning but implements privacy features on top of it. The implementation of federated learning is done in order to increase the privacy of the user and also give them access to their own rich private personalized data. But in the case of classical machine learning the implementation is that it needs all the data and model on one system and in that way we have to get the data of the user and store it in a certain place and then train the model there and get the updated model by training on that data. Let us look at the problems in this system first: the personalized data of the user is being sent to the servers and is used there. Even if the owners of the server are not exploiting the data of users it can be possible by any cyber attacks people can steal the data and use it for their own benefit and in that there is no one to blame for. In order to avoid these data breaches, there can be a solution where we instead to taking the data to the model send the model to the data, that is the core concept of the Federated Learning paradigm - in this way we can preserve the privacy of the user and also train our model on the rich personalized data set.

articleTitle: Implementation Of Object Detection and Identification For Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The issue of visual debilitation or visual deficiency is confronted around the world. As per insights of the World Health Organization (WHO), worldwide, somewhere around 2.2 billion individuals have a dream weakness or visual deficiency, of whom no less than 1 billion are visually impaired. As far as territorial contrasts, the pervasiveness of vision disability in low-and center pay districts is multiple times higher than in big league salary locales. Blind individuals by and large need to depend on white sticks, guide canines, screen-understanding programming, magnifiers, and glasses to help them for versatility, be that as it may, to help the visually impaired individuals the visual world must be changed into the sound world with the possibility to illuminate them about objects as well as their spatial areas. In this manner, we propose to help the outwardly debilitated by presenting a framework that is generally possible, smaller, and financially savvy. The goal of the project is to develop a model an object recognition model to detect and recognize the object for visually impaired people and it can also be used in other markets. Existing techniques for object detection requires a large training data it takes more time and the process is complicated. In this project we propose computer vision concept to recognize object and convert it into text by using the pre trained dataset and the texts are converted further to speech. The system will also support multiple object detection and building a one line description of the object which can be either describe the position of the object or the color. The proposed system can further be implemented in any portable devices for the visually impaired people to recognize objects.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Science Using Bioinformatics Leads To More Effective Treatments
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Few machine learning algorithms have been developed to solve developing difficulties in biological or clinical investigation in past years, thanks to the rapid rise of biomedical information during the last several decades. Because they allow for the automated characteristic collection, selection, or construction of forecasting analytics, these approaches may be utilized in the research of diverse biological processes effectively. A wide range of bioinformatic methodologies, and also maintained resources or biologic networking, are regularly linked with machine learning approaches to improve training & verification, find the most interpretable characteristics, and allow featured or modeling exploration. The approaches discussed here include machine learning in a similar context as approaches from evolution, protein structural assessment, networks biology, or diseases genomics, and they are all described in detail elsewhere. We describe the difficulties that machine learning, and in particular deep learning, faces in biomedicine, but we argue that machine learning methods linked with proven bioinformatics methodologies may provide the distinct potential to solve most of these difficulties.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Management using Soft Computing: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Participating members in a manufacturing supply chain usually use an information system like enterprise resources planning (ERP) for planning and scheduling activities independently. Recent research indicates that there is a need to handle such distributed activities in an integrated manner, especially under uncertain and fast changing environments. A multi agent system, a branch of distributed artificial intelligence, is a contemporary modeling technique for a distributed system in the manufacturing domain. This distributed modeling technique is suitable for integrating supply chain networks, which have distributed entities within the system. Each system makes decision locally, i.e., a local information system. By adopting a multi agent modeling technique, supply chain networks can be built efficiently based on an information system. This paper compile empirical findings on using soft computing technology applications insupply chain management to improve the supply chain efficiency.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection & Incident Response for Information Security: Technologies and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: As the world is rapidly integrating with technology solutions, cyber attackers are always one step ahead, looking for flaws and vulnerabilities in their organizations' systems. Nevertheless, attack violations and constructive attacks are always imminent. Therefore, security teams need to prepare and develop a systematic approach to address such incidents and unwanted intruders. Therefore, intrusion detection and incident response apply security controls to identify malicious activity that affects the organization of internal collaboration by detecting malicious activity from various aspects of the breach. It is also a systematic and systematic approach to addressing, managing, and containing the consequences of security breaches caused by cyberattacks, with the primary objective being to keep the current situation in a way that minimizes and mitigates damage. It is to maintain and contain, loss, cost, and time.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation in Applying Reliable Industry 4.0 Based Machine Learning (ML) Approaches in Analysing and Monitoring Smart Meters using Multivariate Analysis of Variance (Manova)
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Conventional power systems have been evolving towards prospective smart grids in recent decades as market needs have changed and independent innovations, such as the “Internet of Things” (IoT), have developed. The further automation of traditional development of industrial operations with a variety of current advanced techniques is termed as Industry 4.0. The most efficient strategy to boost the productivity of the enterprise environment, such as smart grids, is to use contemporary control technology that regulates and supervises interaction between smart devices. Furthermore, the advancement of loT -enabled smart meters is aided by a separate data connection, such as “Bluetooth” or the “Global System for Mobiles” (GSM), for remotely inspecting and operating smart meters. In this context, SPSS software is used for analysing the role of Industry 4.0 based Machine Learning or ML in analysing Smart Meters and MANOV A (and correlation) approach is considered to get proper result. This study proposes a machine learning-based architecture for analysing and monitoring smart meter data. The advantages of loT integration into Industry 4.0 include the ability to exchange actual information across a wide range of smart meters for various applications, such as factories, hospitals and residences, which is critical for smart grids. Results suggested that Smart Grid is beneficial to the extent of reducing electricity cost; however, maintenance cost and security issues are the major challenging factors in the new technology.

articleTitle: Various Current Mirror Topologies: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In most of the analog and mixed mode circuits, current mirror is the fundamental structure of components included in large electronic systems. High performance of analog structures depends on parameters like output resistance and settling time of current mirrors. High operation speed, small area and less power dissipation are characteristics of circuits built using current mode. In this paper, various current mirror topologies are surveyed based on technology of 90nm. The performance parameters of these technologies like output current, impedance, transconductance and transfer characteristics are also discussed.

articleTitle: lIoT enabled Covid Prevention System with YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The covid-19 pandemic has affected both the health and lifestyle of the people, not only this the global economy also affected badly. The virus spreads at a very high rate and people can easily be infected. So for that people have to take a vaccine that is provided by their government but only vaccination is not a complete solution to this virus. It doesn't gives a full guarantee to prevent people's lives even after the vaccination, so we have to defend ourselves from the spread of the viruses as much as possible. For that mask and social distancing are the main key factor that is also recommended by the government and the public health agencies. As people are not habitual of wearing the mask so many times people forget to wear a mask in public places which is one of the main reasons for the spreading of the virus. Sometimes we see that at crowded places like metro stations and malls and universities, two or three guards are always present, to check the thermal temperature and if people are wearing masks or not and telling people to maintain a social distance. So there are a lot of problems in this because the metro station is a crowded place there people have to make a queue for checking their temperature so it is somehow hard to maintain social distancing and if there is an infected person found in the queue then all other surrounded people will also become infected. So we decided to solve this problem by contributing to the public health sector by making a complete system that will check if people are wearing a mask on their face properly or not. It will also check the thermal temperature of the people through the cameras and checks if someone is not violating social distancing rule. This will prevent people from infected people and also save the time of people. Now a maximum of one guard is needed for monitoring. To make this project practically we are taking the help of machine learning and deep learning. We will be using face detection and recognition algorithms that will be detecting the faces of people. We are using python as programming language. For face detection, we are using YOLO v4(You look only once) which supports a Convolutional neural network. So our process flow will be like that first we import all libraries and after that, we will build a neural network and after that training will be done on a model and then testing the model. After that system will become ready to deploy on the cloud.

articleTitle: A Multiport DC-DC Converter for Plug-in Electric Vehicle Charging with Photovoltaic and Fuel Cell Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The utilization of petroleum products has enormous scope and the natural issues coming about because of the discharge of contaminating gases into the air have made the requirement for change in portability propensities in the present day-to-day routine. Plug-in electric or hybrid vehicles are emerging as a market solution for reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency. The performance of an electric vehicle is heavily reliant on the electrical system's accuracy and efficiency. A series or parallel connection of solar PV modules and charge controllers may be used to supply batteries with electrical power. In order to make use of the ultimate power point in the solar panel, a Maximum Power Point Tracker (MPPT) controller is used. The DC-DC converter boosts the DC voltage generated by the solar PV panel before feeding it to a voltage source inverter. Inverters convert DC electricity provided by solar panels into AC power and then track brushless DC motors, which control vehicle electronics. It is proposed to use DC-DC converters and bidirectional converters to charge EV batteries. If solar energy is insufficient, fuel cells are employed to recharge the battery. The hub motor is coupled with a single-phase alternator in the proposed work, and the power generated while running is fed to the battery. Simulink and MAT LAB are used to simulate and analyze the performance of the hybrid system.

articleTitle: Future Tendency Anticipation for Users in Blogging
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Blogs has now become the world-wide mass media in which anyone share information, ideas and knowledge. The main purpose of blog writing is to connect the blogger to the readers. In this article we are classifying 100 instances of blogging using different algorithms by using weka. We have used different algorithms which are weak learner also known as Decision stump, along with the other algorithm such as Random Forest, Logistic, Logitboost, SMO, including simple Bayes and independence Bayes. For balancing the dataset, we used ensembling blogger [15]. Through this ensembling technique, the dataset is ensembled and enhanced algorithm is used. The final result of optimized algorithms shows that we have achieved better results than other methods.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study of Using Internet of Things (IOT) in Monitoring System for Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Well-designed IoT (Internet of Things) technologies are a major part of real-time system management. The IoT technologies considered wireless sensors to manage power consumption through power management. The sensor networks based on the sensing nodes provide efficient power management tools for the smart connection. The wireless system measures the power voltage and power consumption. Implementation of IoT and other technologies are effective to promote a smart agricultural system over the traditional methods. Secondary qualitative method is used to gather all the data regarding the implementation and the effectiveness of IoT. Findings and analyses suggested that the Basic IoT system is affordable for agricultural farms; however, the inclusion of special features in the smart sensors increases the cost significantly. Moreover, farms and villages have a poor internet connection which results in poor data transfer between farmers and agricultural experts.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning Techniques for Sentiment Analysis on IMDB Datasets
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Social media is an important platform of interaction between people to share their thoughts in the way of views and opinions on some issue or story, resulting in a massive volume of unstructured knowledge. Sentiment analysis is the most commonly applied method for predicting user feedback. In the past era, numerous machine learning and natural language processing-based methods were utilised to investigate these feelings. Deep learning-based methods, on the other hand, are rapidly gaining popularity due to their high efficiency. This study uses a combination of deep learning methods, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) models to analyse movie feedback. With respect to Precision, Recall, F-measure, and Accuracy, the suggested CNN-BiLSTM Hybrid System surpasses traditional Deep Learning and machine learning methodologies, according to the results of the assessments. This methodology provided good results on the IMDB movie reviews dataset using hybrid Deep Learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Consensus Algorithm of Hierarchical Partition Blockchain for Virtual Power Plant Transactions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With the construction of new power systems, the proportion of new energy power generation will gradually increase, and the energy transaction of virtual power plants will become more complex and challenging. With the increase in the number of energy entities involved in virtual power plants, the traditional centralized dispatching method can no longer meet the needs of the development of virtual power plants. The decentralization, tamper resistance and smart contracts of the blockchain can improve the transaction efficiency of virtual power plants. However, with the increasing number of distributed users participating in transactions, the consensus delay of the blockchain in completing transactions hinders the expansion of the blockchain network..This paper first proposes a blockchain-based virtual power plant system architecture, and expounds the relationship and role of each level. Later, a blockchain partition consensus algorithm for virtual power plant transactions was proposed, namely Partition Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PPBFT). Finally, using OMNET++ to simulate the algorithm in this paper, it is concluded that when the number of nodes increases, the algorithm can effectively reduce the consensus time and improve the fairness and timeliness of transactions.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Hybrid Word Representation for Detection of Hate Speech
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this era of very easy access to information, it has become very easier for anyone to share their ideas, opinions and beliefs. Internet being the most used space for all lets every user share their thoughts with just a click. With a lot of people sharing their ideas and opinions, it is obvious that there can be some dissatisfactions. Internet has witnessed some of the greatest social movements in the history. With smartphones available in every hand, people can join the movement easily and express their opinions. Social movements are drives related to a particular community which gets attention from the entire world. Social media mostly gets polarized into two parts, one in support of the movement and another in opposition of the movement. Machine learning algorithms give us the power to do the analysis of people's sentiment in the internet. Using the power of machine learning and its applications, this paper tries to do the fundamental analysis of which sides the twitter users are leaning to subsequently enable recognizing hate speech. With the help of tweets publicly available, the analysis is done using multiple deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Predicting Distributed Denial of Service Attacks in Machine Learning Field
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A persistent and serious danger to the Internet is a denial of service attack on a large scale (DDoS) attack using machine learning. Because they originate at the low layers, new Infections that use genuine hypertext transfer protocol requests to overload target resources are more untraceable than application layer-based cyberattacks. Using network flow traces to construct an access matrix, this research presents a method for detecting distributed denial of service attack machine learning assaults. Independent component analysis decreases the number of attributes utilized in detection because it is multidimensional. Independent component analysis can be used to translate features into high dimensions and then locate feature subsets. Furthermore, during the training and testing phase of the updated source support vector machine for classification, their performance it is possible to keep track of the detection rate and false alarms. Modified source support vector machine is popular for pattern classification because it produces good results when compared to other approaches, and it outperforms other methods in testing even when given less information about the dataset. To increase classification rate, modified source support Vector machine is used, which is optimized using BAT and the modified Cuckoo Search method. When compared to standard classifiers, the acquired findings indicate better performance.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of an UWB antenna for MIMO applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\times 2$</tex> radiator configuration, ultrawide band (UWB), compact antenna is presented in this article. Impedance matching is reached by using defected-ground-structure (DGS) and trapezoid shape radiator. MIMO configuration is designed using two identical radiators parallel to each other. Proposed structure has excited various resonating modes that produces to wide impedance bandwidth. High gain of 4.43 dB is achieved with proposed geometry. Over the entire resonating frequency (from 3 GHz to 11 GHz band) antenna shows port isolation above 12 dB. Diversity gain is more than 9.94 and envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) less than 0.05 shows diversity performance of antenna. Results shows that proposed structure is an appropriate structure for MIMO-UWB applications.

articleTitle: Design of a Microgrid Based on Case Study With ETAP
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: As the grid supply isn't solid and the cost of power is continued expanding, it is important to sustainable power sources like sun oriented, battery, wind into grid framework. Micro-grid innovation has raised interests among individuals as it helps to boost its functional productivity, to maximize its operational efficiency and bringing down the all-out cost. The recreation has performed for various condition with the assistance of ETAP programming, which is the most comprehensive analysis platform for the design and simulation of power system. Load flow analysis is the fundamental for electrical power system design, electrical power system planning, performance monitoring and to ensure reliable micro-grid activity. For detailed analysis, IEEE 9 bus based Micro-Grid system has been designed which consists of a diesel generator, solar PV array, energy storage system, wind turbine, and battery bank to perform simulation for different case studies combined with the models in ETAP software in order to check the feasibility of various cases in the practical world.

articleTitle: The Predictive Model of Mental Illness using Decision Tree and Random Forest classification in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Ministry of HFW, Government of India ordered the NIMNS - National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences, Bengaluru, in alliance with 15 institutions from across India and made a survey on mental health issues. This commission covered 12 states, one among that is Punjab from Northern region. As per the report, 15% of the adults in India need treatment for mental disorder. Machine Learning is one of the most substantial proportions of Artificial Intelligence. Machine Learning is widely used in many fields like online fraud detection, speech recognition, and social media. It plays a vital role in healthcare sector. This boosts the interest on the detection of the mental illness using machine learning algorithm. The big challenge is to predict the state of mind. Psychologists impose assessment and therapy to their patients by one to one physical interactions. There are multiple causes to put the person into critical situation like depression, pressure etc. Hence, this research paper proposes an ideal solution to identify the sickness in the person by checking with the recorded dataset. The most preferred Supervised Machine Learning algorithm, Decision Tree Classifier is used for this purpose. The initial goal of the Decision Tress is to create training ideal which is used to forecast the target variable class. The parameters considered here are anxiety disorder, depression disorder and the stress. Random Forest algorithm is applied to predict the illness in the people. The result obtained is to have accurate prediction level compared to the existing model.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Classify Types of Crop and Associated Disease by using Inception V3
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Crop diseases can essentially influence the yield of harvest creation and farming. An agrarian produce that is polluted by infection can cause the rancher incredible misfortunes as far as financial misfortunes. Given the way that India's significant populace is engaged with farming, it is fundamental for infections to be identified at a beginning phase. For viable sickness the board, it is critical that infections are distinguished in the beginning phases of their turn of events and are precisely recognized when they arise. A farmer can be benefited by our application created as it assists them with identifying the infection of the given harvest leaves pictures. We will show how to distinguish sicknesses in crops in this paper utilizing their leaves. Our undertaking is equipped for foreseeing sicknesses in excess of five crops. There is a chat bot for personalized help.

articleTitle: An Efficient Machine Learning Method for Inter-Turn Fault Detection and Torque Control in Bldc Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Nowadays, the brushless dc machines are highly involved in many applications and having high demand and rugged performance. During some tough situation which occurs in aircraft the motor must be well-grounded. In this situation an innovative model of detecting the fault method is evolved for limiting the speed of the BLDC motor. Below the deliberation of the complication of dynamic featuring the control system of BLDC motor with an analytic problem solving, LRGF is a technique of Artificial Neural Network with pole work method which is moved to design the system. During the fault analysis method, the fault signal was segregated with LRGFNN online. In between the adaptive lifting technique and adaptive threshold technique which are dispensed for identifying the faults from the separated fault signals in the presence of the errors such as mechanical and electrical errors. The performance of the fault identification system is denoted in motor which having the electrical simulation fault and mechanical fault. The vibration fault and over load fault are also identified.

articleTitle: Plant Disorder and Disease Detection Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The lack of timely detection of diseases in crops or not getting information about the presence of the disease at the right time indicates a dangerous situation, to avoid this and to know about the disease in the crop, image processing technology can be used, by using the steps- Image acquisition, pre-processing of the image, Segmentation of image samples, Feature extraction, Detection and classification of plant disease.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of MIMO filter using current conveyor
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With the progression of technology, current model-based circuits escalated massively. Here in this paper, a new voltage mode-based circuit layout of universal filter using current conveyor is presented. The configuration that has been put forward uses six resistors, six capacitors and two current conveyors. The suggested circuit functions represent low pass filter (LPF), high pass filter (HPF) and band pass filter (BPF) function while taking different input and output port combinations. Additionally, the tunability for Low Pass filter and Band Pass Filter is also performed while changing the resistance of the circuit which further affects the gain of the circuit. The response for the proposed design is simulated in PSPICE

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Automated Solar Panel Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The objective of the proposed paper is to examine or study the performance of automated solar panel tracking system. It ensures that the solar panel is placed at the right angle(90 degree) with respect to sun's position to obtain maximum solar energy. An eccentric feature or characteristic of this system is that the earth has not taken as the testimonial. Instead of that here the reference is sun. The sensor in the system constantly invigilate the sunlight and turn or rotate the panel with regard to the angle at which the intensity of the sunlight is very high. The LDR (Light Dependent Resistor) sense the position change of the sun which is dealt by the respective change in the panel's position by controlling the geared motor. It has the program to run the motor with respect to the variation in the position of the sun, 25% to 30% energy is generated. In this paper, an improvement in the design of existing system is achieved to get the best efficiency economically.

articleTitle: Investigating the Role of Block Chain to Secure Identity in IoT for Industrial Automation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Everyone who has an app that can access the block chain can get their hands on the data. There are blocks for each new piece of data that come in. A chronological chain of data is formed when a block is filled with data and chained to the previous block. Smart things are protected from cyber-attacks thanks to the IoT's technology's transparency and virtual incorruptibility. The block chain may be used to enable secure connectivity between IoT devices by storing data in transactions and confirming those transactions with nodes. The Internet of Things (IOT) has helped industrial automation reach new heights. We can improve the security and privacy by adding block chain to it.

articleTitle: Partial discharge Source Calibration of Radiated Partial Discharge Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Based on the IEC 60270 guideline, a galvanic quantification along with free-space radiometry (FSR) method are used to measure partial discharge (PD) simultaneously. The PD source is a floating-electrode emulator type that was custom built. Sources are powered by AC or DC, power supplies. A biconical antenna captures the emitted a signal. The frequency band is derived from performing an Time-domain pulsing FFT analytics. The adjustment of a floating-electrode PD supply is focused for the advancement of a PD wireless sensor network (WSN).

articleTitle: Automatic Soil Moisture Control and Seed Sowing using Agrobot
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Agrobot is a farm robot. It is intended to reduce farmer labour while also increasing work speed and accuracy. We have presented a system of approach for designing and developing a smart seed sowing robotic vehicle for agricultural applications in this paper. The soil sensor is used to test the moisture content of the soil, and the seed sowing machine is used to automatically sow the seeds. Increased population necessitates increased food production, which necessitates better cultivation in the form of proper seed and fertilizer use with minimal labour. The qualitative approach is to create a system that minimizes the farmer's work while also reducing the time spent on seed sowing, digging, and water waste. The moisture level indicator is important because it aids in water conservation. A soil sensor measures the moisture level in the soil and sends the data to the ARDUINO controller. The developed robotic system is fully automated, reducing the farmers' workload.

articleTitle: Assessing and Comparing the Role of Machine Learning (ML) and Supply Chain Management (SCM) Towards Enhancing E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The current dynamism of the business environment revolves around supply chain management as the Organisation are poised in procuring the raw materials, transport it to the warehouse for processing and then distributing to the customers. The time and effort involved in the distribution channels need to be reduced so that the customers get the products on time and will save more cost for the Organisation. The implementation of machine learning (ML) tools enables the management in using various technologies to track the purchase request, enable in monitoring the movement of goods on a real time basis and take proper action so that the products are delivered on time to the customers. The advent of internet has enabled the customers to procure goods and services through online and this has enabled in increasing the revenues and profitability of the business. Hence, the management are focused in using various technologies to strengthen their SCM so that the goods can be tracked on a real time basis and support in achieving the sustainable development. It can be regarded that the today's competitive environment enables in realizing the customer expectation in an effective manner, the impact of globalization has compelled many companies to be highly competent in servicing their customers effectively This study is more focused in understanding the impact of ML in enhancing the SCM operations in the Organisation, the current pandemic situation has forced companies to rethink their strategies on the supply chain management so as to enhance the performance, reduce cost and meet the needs of the customers in an effective manner. The paper enables in understanding the critical issues and analyses the association with the ecommerce for achieving sustainable development. The study will apply positivism research design as it supports the researcher to understand the area of study in a more elaborate manner, furthermore the researcher uses quantitative research tools for gathering the data and make profundo analysis so as to make appropriate understanding on the subject area. Also, the researcher uses both primary and secondary source for performing the study in an effective manner. The entire study will enable in apprehending the gaps in research which poised to compare the role of ML and SCM in enhancing e-commerce in the future business environment.

articleTitle: A Kinematic Study of Convertible Wheelchair and Amalgamation With the IoT Features
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Wheelchairs have become an integral part of daily lives of many disabled and injured people since their advent. They have provided a significant value in terms of improvement of living standards. The main objective of this proposed work is to provide an efficient and easy solution for accomplishing the complex functions of convertible wheelchair (especially the Propulsion and Conversion mechanism) by proposing, designing and evaluating a novel wheelchair mechanism. Furthermore, the work also proposes an (IoT) Internet of Things based framework of controlling various functions of chair. The key design features of proposed model of wheelchair includes easy conversion (from chair to stretcher and vice versa), an easier propulsion mechanism and proposed integration with few loT based features. The CAD model was prepared and found to be extremely satisfactory in terms of all above said parameters. It has also shown its value for money, considering the fabrication simplicity, utilization of very basic mechanisms and low-cost spare parts. The spare parts utilized are easily available in the marketplace which further provides the value addition to the project. Lastly, several approaches to add the loT features, which could further enhance the credibility of product, have been discussed and reviewed.

articleTitle: A multi-objective evolutionary feature selection approach for the classification of multi-label data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: There has been a growing need to resolve the Curse Of Dimensionality (COD) in multi-label data in recent years, which has attracted much attention for Feature Selection (FS). The multi-label FS method has gotten a lot of interest since it can considerably increase classification accuracy by selecting important features. Here, we have designed a binary version of multi-objective FS approach for Multi-Label Classification (MLC) based upon Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA). Instead of a random search in WOA, we have applied the tournament search for the selection of a new whale. Tournament Selection (TS) entails holding a series of “tournaments” among a select group of people randomly from the general population. Here the multi-objective criteria consist of two objectives; where the first objective is to maximize the Jaccard similarity, and the another is to reduce the selected features. To check the robustness of the proposed method, we have used multi-label datasets from different areas. We added a comparative analysis of the proposed methodology with various traditional machine learning and multi-label classifiers. Empirical results on widely used multi-label datasets show that proposed FS achieves competitive performance, especially when labels are limited.

articleTitle: Circumstantial Discussion on Security and Privacy Protection using Cloud Computing Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Cloud computing is becoming a demanding technology due to its flexibility, sensibility and remote accessibility. Apart from these applications of cloud computing, privacy and security are two terms that pose a circumstantial discussion. Various authors have argued on this topic that cloud computing is more secure than other data sharing and storing methods. The conventional data storing system is a computer system or smartphone storage. The argument debate also states that cloud computing is vulnerable to enormous types of attacks which make it a more concerning technology. This current study has also tried to draw the circumstantial and controversial debate on the security and privacy system of cloud computing. Primary research has been conducted with 65 cloud computing experts to understand whether a cloud computing security technique is highly secure or not. An online survey has been conducted with them where they provided their opinions based on the security and privacy system of cloud computing. Findings showed that no particular technology is available which can provide maximum security. Although the respondents agreed that blockchain is a more secure cloud computing technology; however, the blockchain also has certain threats which need to be addressed. The study has found essential encryption systems that can be integrated to strengthen security; however, continuous improvement is required.

articleTitle: Review of IoT Technologies used in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Now a days Indian agriculture is declining it disturbs the production. It is essential to solve this problem in agriculture field to improve the growth of the crops. The solution for this low growth of crops is the use of modernize the way of monitoring the agricultural fields. The use of internet of things in the agriculture improves the smart agriculture. The different applications of IoT are enhance the way of agriculture. Internet of Things information technologies and techniques provide different applications of agriculture such as irrigation, water monitoring, soil monitoring, pesticides control techniques. Different remote systems and wireless communication techniques are used in agriculture. Various sensors and models for monitoring are introduced using IoT technologies. Experiments are performed on the different IoT sensors and IoT systems which provide knowledge and smart results for smart agriculture. The combination of sensors and agriculture can enhance the development of techniques of smart agriculture, effective solutions to the issues of agriculture and improve the growth.

articleTitle: Drought prediction using artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Drought has been one of the most frightening natural calamity that is being faced by the humans., and it is generally faced by the farmers all around the world. It can occur anywhere in the world and is also known as one of the slow disaster as it stays for a very longer time period and maybe even more if it wants to be harsher. Drought not only impacts the human life but also the agriculture, world economies and energy that had been infiltrated by the farmers. Everything goes on stakes during this calamity and the basic needs such as food are not easy to get during these times and the inflammation is at peak due to supply and demand instability. There are many ways which can be done to avoid the drought, which include drip irrigation to save water during the times of drought, rainwater harvesting can also be a saviour, crop engineering, desalination of water and many more things. The main solution for this would be to analyse the weather and the future outcomes of it which would help in preparing for the worse situation and also the soil prediction can help a lot when it comes to predicting this situation. The paper aims to take the data of weather and soil together to predict how droughts can be avoided. Deep learning techniques will help to get a great idea if the drought is going to happen or not.

articleTitle: Machine Learning as a Predictive Technology And Its Impact on Digital Pricing and Cryptocurrency Markets
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this current era, Machine Learning (ML) Approach is widely used as a predictive technology in transportation, finance, advertising, travel, healthcare, and various manufacturing industries across the globe. The modern-day financial market around the globe has experienced its deep impact on various aspects of digital pricing. Enormous organizations use numerous digital pricing techniques in order to generate maximum profit percentages for a sustainable future while conducting global business. On the other hand, the effective applications of the machine learning approach also offer relevant advantages in the Cryptocurrency Markets worldwide. It has been identified that with the use of ML approaches, organizations can conduct faster as well as cheaper transfers and exchange of money through virtual mediums easier than before. Moreover, Machine learning can easily improve all the trading strategies in the cryptocurrency and digital pricing markets for gaining more profit as well as adaptable business experience for future experiments. Researchers are going to investigate the particular research topic with an effective quantitative method by conducting secondary method as well as asking topic-related questions. In the modern share markets, undertaking numerous innovative ML technologies for enhancing efficiency in digital pricing and cryptocurrency has become easier. Therefore, the research paper sheds some important light on the impacts of ML approaches and their contributions in cryptocurrency trading and digital pricing for obtaining further research scopes.

articleTitle: Role of Machine Learning in Managing Cloud Computing Security
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Cloud computing is one of the most trending technology through which digitalized data management and storing becomes easier and more effective. However, besides the advancement of technology, data protection is another top priority concerning factor as millions of sensitive data are gets stored and transferred through the cloud computing system. As per the current days of cyber-activities, data security threat in cloud computing have increased, which posses threat in the development of the business. In that field, machine learning based advanced algorithm develop the virtual encrypted environment to protect the data from unauthorized access and hacking.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Software Engineering: Configurability Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: At first view, AI utility in software program engineering appears an ambiguity in phrases due to the fact synthetic intelligence is set routinizing processes with the aid of using depending on “shrewd machines” even as software program engineering, is an innovative and know-how in depth action, commonly related to human experts. Early estimation of configurability constantly facilitates to enhance layout, and might in the end result in nice promise. Practitioners emphasize at the want of getting a prepared and green method for configurability valuation. For this motive there's a want to expand an extra logical answer for configurability valuation at layout section. A for mentioned records inspired the academician to create the exertion on this path in addition to to expand a complete configurability valuation structure besides version to degree item orientated software's program configurability by the side of layout section of improvement existence cycle. In order to cope with the above studies gaps, the hassle announcement that has been formulated for the observe is recognized as ‘artificial intelligence for software engineering: configurability perspective’ In order to cope with the above studies gaps, the hassle announcement that has been formulated for the observe is recognized as 'configurability valuation framework and valuation model of object oriented software.

articleTitle: Data Reduction Techniques in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are an active research area due to their wide range of applications in almost every aspect of life and their associated challenges, including energy conservation, longer life cycle, and better utilization of resources. Their presence in such large quantities also leads to a tremendous amount of sensor data to be stored and processed efficiently. This poses a new challenge as the sensor nodes are often deployed in harsh environments, where cheaper resources are needed to collect and process data. Data reduction is one such technique that helps in reducing the amount of sensor data. In this paper, a review of data reduction techniques has been presented. An analysis of various data reduction techniques proposed over the years, their benefits and challenges, how they help, their pros and cons, and if the employment of data reduction techniques is worthy in such resource-constrained environments has been presented.

articleTitle: Hybrid Soft Computing Based Approach for Ageing in Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Soft Computing is a set of techniques for addressing special class of complex problems which involve the use of computationally intelligent systems. The fusion of Deep Learning and Soft Computing tools like Neural Networks has shown a promising road ahead for computationally intensive problems, giving rise to algorithms and solutions with high efficiency and accuracy. Application of this fusion technique considerably improves the accuracy of recognizing faces in a facial recognition pipeline. Our hybrid model comprising of CNN & LSTM utilizes DCN'S which work on the concept of optimization of the embedding's of the face itself. Our proposed system has been tested on the CACD dataset and gives very promising & encouraging results

articleTitle: Financial Market Sentiment Prediction Technology and Application Based on Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the real word, a variety of situation may occur where strategy control becomes mandatory to make effective decision. In order to meet this requirements, combination of reinforcement learning and sentiment analysis is important that also may help to show theoretical research direction. This research work displays the feature of the machine learning related to the sentiment analysis and deep reinforcement learning to determine the Financial Market sensitivity. The experimental results can help to achieve better gains by demonstrating the advantages of the machine learning based model over existing traditional reinforcement learning model for predicting financial market.

articleTitle: Histogram Equalization variants preserving non uniform illuminated images
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: It is always a big concern to improve the condition of an image when it comes to fine details of under and over-exposed images. To enhance the fine details of images, an optimal enhancement technique is required. A lot more techniques are suggested in past. Among them, histogram equalization (HE) would be considered as best. The histogram is broadly used to amplify the contrast of an image for its clarity and directness. The main drawback of this technique is the flattening effect in graph that uniformly distributes the gray level. Several modifications of the technique have been made to overcome the barriers of the traditional histograms and enhance the non-uniform illuminated images. This paper provides insight into histograms and their versions. Moreover, the proposed paper proceeds with checking the quality parameter of techniques. The paper concluded the optimal method to be implemented on non-uniform illuminated images using the histogram equalization method.

articleTitle: Cosmological Models based on Artificial Intelligence Approach for Conharmonically Flat Space Time
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The present research work explores artificial intelligence based cosmological models for conharmonically flat spacetime. There has been presumed a linear relationship between Deceleration parameter and Hubble parameter, i.e., q=α+ßH to obtain the cosmological models. For different parameters, the cosmological models depend on time have been developed. Then, the data set for all the cosmological parameters such as density, pressure, cosmological constant and expansion scalar have been generated by using developed analytical models. The generated data set has been utilized to build up ANN based cosmological models for the cosmological parameters mentioned above. Finally, the reliability of the ANN models has been verified and behavior of the universe with time has also been studied.

articleTitle: An experimental analysis of state-of-the-art Time Series Prediction models
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Various prediction problems encompass a time element and consequently entail extrapolating data or prediction. Time series prediction is one of the most employed data mining models in business, finance, weather forecasting, and pattern recognition. Prediction comprises selecting models to fit historical data and utilizing them to foretell future reflections. The future is predicted or established on whatever has previously occurred. Time series appends a time-order dependency amongst observations. This dependency is both a constriction and construction that offers a basis of added intelligence. In this paper, an experimental analysis of various state-of-the-art time series prediction models has been presented. The analysis has been done for three datasets, and results have been evaluated based on MAE, MSE, RMSE, R2, and Average time per data point.

articleTitle: A Bluetooth, UWB, X- & Partial Ku Band Cross Elliptical Patch Antenna with Embedded Band Stop Filter Feature
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This research reports a single notched band antenna for multiple wireless applications. The proposed work is fabricated on FR4 substrate with dual cros-elliptical patch printed on one plane and partial ground on opposite plane. The proposed measured bandwidth covers 2.346GHz-13.77 GHz with elimination of WiMAX (3.14GHz-3.72GHz) interference. The proposed antenna offers maximum gain of 5.96dBi and radiation efficiency of 89%. The proposed antenna is suitable for applications including Bluetooth, UWB, X- and partial Ku bands.

articleTitle: Virtual Machine selection and migration in Cloud Paradigm: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Cloud Computing provides larger scale resources using virtualization that delivers computing services like databases, networking, hardware, software, intelligence and so on. It provides an alternative to on-premises resources. But there is a need of dynamic consolidation of VMs for energy consumption, load balancing, total number of migrations, QoS and improvement in Service Level Agreement Violation (SLA-V) which will further leads to enhanced utilization of resources. To optimize the migration time, energy consumption, SLA-V, it is essential to migrate the load of underloaded and overloaded resources for balancing the load of data centers. Author mentioned various techniques in the literature for improving the performance and resources used in load balancing, energy consumption, resource management and QoS.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Neural Networks and Deep Learning using Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Scientists in recent times have experienced a broad utilization of both deep learning approaches and neural networks through wireless communication. However, these deep learning approaches can offer better decision-making and predictions for future activities. On the other hand, neural networks can learn regularly by themselves and provide relevant output that is unlimited to the offered input. With the application of both DL and NN via wireless communication, reaping the merits of the modern-day digital economy has become easier than before. Researchers in the research paper has successfully conducted a comparative analysis between DL and NN. While NN can be used to transmit data in both input-output values via wireless connections, DL at once enhances the data transformation scopes for a better and more sustainable future. Primary research has been conducted with 60 individuals to understand their practical knowledge on the topic. The data was collected in a way to support the comparative analysis of this research. After the primary research analysis, secondary data has been analyzed as well to support the primary research findings. Findings showed that Deep Learning (DL) has outcompeted the Neural Network (NN) in terms of benefits in wireless communication. The DL has the capacity to manage enormous amounts of data which is not possible using NN. Moreover, DL is effective in storing historical data and can process complex information better than NN.

articleTitle: Secure Key Exchange and Authentication Mechanism for XML Document using Lagrange's Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The confidentiality and integrity of the data must be ensured over any communication channel so that users can trust the received data. Lower layers of TCP/IP network could ensure the security of data but not securing data at application level would cause the data leakage. One common key used for the encryption of the messages in the entire session could be compromised if an intruder gains an access to the common key. The key exchange algorithm proposed in this paper utilizes Lagrange's interpolation for formulating the polynomial and deriving the new encryption key for every message sent in a session. The key exchange mechanism doesn't use explicit handshake messages for sharing the new key instead it uses piggybacked key exchange mechanism in which the information regarding the new key is embedded in the response message. The performance analysis of Lagrange's interpolation-based algorithm is performed w.r.t the Newton forward interpolationbased method.

articleTitle: A Study of Various Classification Algorithms to Reveal Anomaly during Fingerprint Presentation on Biometric Sensor Based on Naïve Feature Vector On Two Separate Region
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Fingerprint biometric-based application suffers from a problem, in which no genuine biometric sample known as a spoof sample is classified as a live presentation. To overcome this problem the research community is proposing new algorithms or adopting existing state-of-art. In continuation, this work proposes a naïve feature vector computed from two independent image regions to analyze various classifiers' performance to validate feature vector design. In this work, the first step is to calculate the region of interest (ROI) using factorized directional band-pass (FBD) segmentation algorithm to remove unwanted regions. The two regions proposed are region-I and region-II. The (region-is composed of four (non-overlapping) sub-regions calculated using the Otsu thresholding algorithm. The second region (region-comprises six sub-regions (overlapping) using activity mask, noticeable artifacts mask, noise mask, and their image negatives. For feature selection, this work proposes to use five different no-reference image quality assessments (IQA) metrics. These are perception-based image quality evaluator (PIQE), naturalness image quality evaluator (NIQE), and its model blind/reference less image spatial quality evaluator (BRISQUE) and its model. The two feature design consists of a total of 38 and 24 features respectively. To test the accuracy of the proposed methodology all 25 binary classifier algorithm available in MATLAB has experimented with 10-fold cross-validation. This experiment uses cross-sensor and cross-material experimental validation on two different datasets LivDet2013 and LivDet2015. The proposed method achieved 99.8% reasonable accuracy with the Bagged Tree Ensemble learning classifier with cross-sensor and cross-material combinations using 38 features. Further, another classifier performs fairly well with 24 features in a lower combination of datasets which is comparable with existing state-of-art methods. The experimental result verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method, which is a good candidate for a futuristic open-set solution. This experiment can be recreated and experimented on a larger combinational dataset for the generalization of results as future work for the proposed study.

articleTitle: Internet Of Things: A Study on Protocols, Security Challenges and Healthcare Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) provides the connectivity, interaction and exchange of data among electronic devices, vehicles and home appliances. IoT provides connectivity to internet enabled smart devices as well as non-internet-enabled dumb devices. By using technology; communication and interaction is possible among these devices and make it possible to control and monitor these devices remotely. For creating any IoT enabled application, sensors are being used to have an interaction between the real and digital world. This review study is taken into account for analysis in the time period between 2010–2021 from three databases SCOPUS, SCI and IEEE. The selected literature has been grouped into four categories IoT in healthcare, IoT security issues, IoT security possible solutions and IoT messaging protocols. The main objective of this paper is to review and analyze the existing work related to use of IoT in healthcare, issues and challenges of IoT deployment. This review could benefit the IoT researchers and developers by providing an overview regarding the use of IoT, applications, security issues and opportunities for future research.

articleTitle: Analysis on optimal ways to secure image encryption and decryption
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the last two decades chaos has been among the most important cryptology design methods to design modern encryption algorithms. So in this review paper we have addressed various techniques, security attacks, NPCR and UACI values, key size and the various key definitions, the advantages and disadvantages of various chaos based cryptosystems with special focus on designing, analyzing and implementing cryptographic algorithms that allow peoples and entities to interact securely with each other.

articleTitle: Comparitive Analysis of Reduction Methods Applied on Single Input Single Output Higher Order System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)

The model order reduction of denominator is done by implementing pole clustering, clustering of pole has been adjusted and also has been enhanced algorithms to generate groups of poles in the real system on the other hand, method used for the coefficients of numerator polynomials keeping constant were wangled by using simple mathematical algorithm. The suggested algorithm is quality similar and calculated based if the high-order system that started it all is steady, this procedure assures the stability of the reduced model. A deep literature analysis is tabulated along with the individual gaps of the surveyed literature and the proposed method is implemented trying to bridge the gaps discovered by the survey. The proposed way of approach is described where examples from literature helped. Along with this, a comparison is made on the basis of system specification of the real system and the system reduced by various methods such as pole clustering, modified and changed pole clustering and improvised pole clustering technique and traced characteristics observed using transient and frequency specifications of the considered system and the reduced systems.

abstract: This article compares the Concentrated Solar Power plants, optical efficiency, incident flux of a few potential locations with diverse climatic conditions, including Rajasthan (Arid), UP (Sub-Tropical), Karnataka (Tropical), Ladakh (cold & dry), and Assam (Tropical), as well as the economic aspects of each of these places. articleTitle: Micro-Grid Relay Coordination Using ETAP
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The uninterrupted electrical power system must be set up to be safe, stable and reliable for the contemporary power system. The authors of this article use ETAP simulation to model the IEEE 9-Bus based Micro-Grid system and use relay coordination to analyze the results. Research results show that the behavior of the Micro-Grid system when three phase fault occurs on different buses having the different renewable energy sources used in the bus system. In the given paper the protection scheme is furnished with the overcurrent relay is tested using ETAP on a micro-grid having multiple renewable sources like wind turbine, solar panel and diesel generator at several fault locations.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Controlling Data Through the Internet of Things (IOT) System: A Framework to Measure the Public Health
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Associating and sharing information by means of the web between actual things, or “things,” coordinated with sensors, programming, and different advances are known as the Internet of Things (IoT). articleTitle: Investigating the Role of Image Processing to Identify Pattern for Industrial Automation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: When both the input and the output are images, image processing is used. It was given its name because of its focus on image processing. Imaging and signal processing, as well as image enhancement and voice signal processing, can all be done on this platform. In order for an image or video to be identified, a specific object or feature must be found. In this study, CBIR is used to discover patterns. articleTitle: Battery Management System – A Simplified Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)

articleTitle: IoT Based Solution for the safety of Rolling Shutters
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: IoT (Internet of Things) is a network that allows various objects to communicate with each other. articleTitle: Sliding Mode Backstepping Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this paper sliding mode backstepping controller is proposed to extract maximum power from PV and to get desired grid voltage from battery of the PV battery system. The use of sliding surface in the backstepping procedure makes the error variable vanishes in quick time, which in turn the desired control law is obtained with enhanced transient and steady state responses. On basis of Lyapunov control function, control law obtained in order to obtain asymptotic stable system. The simulations are done for the wide range of variations at the input and output side. The obtained simulation results of the SMBS controller is compared with PID controller which shows that proposed controller outperforms PID controller in terms of transient and steady state response.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Effectiveness of ML Agents in Enhancing the Predictive Model in Decision Making for Medical Practitioners in the Healthcare Industry: A Structural Equation Model Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In order to enhance the effectiveness of the clinical predictive model, ML agents are at once essential in healthcare sectors. articleTitle: Four-Port MIMO Array With Square Patch And Dual Filters for IoT-Wideband Applications

abstract: This paper reports compact 4×4 MIMO (multi-input-multi-output ports) antenna configuration for Bluetooth, ISM, UWB and X-band with impedance bandwidth of 1.84GHz-11.33GHz. articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Deep Learning Models Efficacy for Brain Tumor Detection

articleTitle: Role of Integrated Artificial Intelligence for Knowledge Creation and Decision Making for Improving Firm Performance

articleTitle: An Enhanced Rapid and Effective Algorithm to Remove Various Noise in Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Rapid and Effective (RE) technique that can remove various types of noise with minimal computing cost. From the noise-corrupted image, the algorithm calculates the extent of noise corruption. In another step, the mean value of some of the nearby pixels is used to replace the centre pixel, which is based on a threshold value. Two opposing parameters are noise removal with edge preservation and computational complexity. For these requirements, the recommended approach is the best option. The algorithm's performance is compared to that of conventional mean filters (MF), wiener filters (WF), alpha trimmed mean filters (ATMF), K- means filters (KMF), bilateral filters (BF), and the recently suggested trilateral filter (TF). In terms of equally individual and objective calculations, new results expose that the proposed filtering algorithm outperforms existing common algorithms. The suggested solution minimises different noise and improves edge preservation while requiring fewer computational complexity, making it simple to implement in hardware.

articleTitle: Transfer learning based Covid-19 detection using Radiography Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: COVID-19 is a worldwide pandemic that affected health care and lifestyle all over the world and early discovery is critical for controlling virus spread and mortality. The principal diagnostic test is the RT -PCR test, while test results are pending, spotting probable COVID19 infections on a chest X-ray may aid in restricting high-risk individuals if the diagnosis is done early. Most medical systems have X-Ray equipment, and since most modern X-Ray systems are automated, there is no need to transfer samples. Therefore, we recommend building a Deep Convolutional Neural Network-based technique that works on Radiography images for identifying COVID-19 positive patients. Here we have applied transfer-learning over some widely used deep CNN models like NasNet, DenseNet121, VGG19, ResNet50, and Xception. We have compared the performance of each model by running them over the COVID19 Radiography Dataset. Around 40K chest X-ray photos of COVID patients were used to build training, test, and validation sets. Since earlier research, there has been significant improvement in the number of data points to better train the CNN models. This study aims to identify the best of the available solutions that can be used by medical staff to swiftly discover COVID positive persons by just using the patient's Chest X-Ray diagnosis.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer and a Comparison of its Present Prediction Algorithms

abstract: Among every single illness which has attracted a breath mankind it has been seen that cellular breakdown in the lungs has turned up as one the very pinnacle of serious over and over. articleTitle: The Role of Smart Grid Data Analytics in Enhancing the Paradigm of Energy Management for Sustainable Development

abstract: The energy industry is witnessing massive growth due to increase demand of power, hence the business enterprises, stakeholders and governments are focusing in implementing novel measures so as to enhance the overall efficiency of operations. The implementation of various technologies in the grids supports the energy providers, users and others in enhancing the efficiency of operations, identify the areas of latency, enable in deploying the resources effectively for better future.
