articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Image Recognition and Classification through Machine Learning and Transfer Learning Approaches using Multiple Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Image recognition and classification have taken a shift from the conventional detection process by humans to detection by Machine Learning (ML) and Transfer Learning (TL). These two approaches are being applied in various image identification processes for human development. The research paper identified the accuracy rates of three architectures in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs); such as AlexNet, GoogleNet and ResNet. Different sources have been evaluated to collect the accuracy rates of these three CNN architectures. These architectures were trained with a definite number of resources having the same features (1000) and accuracy was calculated after every training day. The accuracy rate was kept on Excel and regression analysis was accomplished in SPSS to identify how one-day training improves the accuracy of these architectures. Moreover, training days and layers were identified for each architecture to compare the research data and to evaluate further. Findings suggested that AlexNet is more accurate in machine learning image recognition and classification, and it requires less time for training than GoogleNet and ResNet; whereas, due to having few layers, AlexNet is less accurate in Transfer Learning.

articleTitle: Feature Selection with Stochastic Hill-Climbing Algorithm in Cross Project Defect Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Existing research has shown that carefully chosen training data can improve cross-project fault prediction performance (CPDP). In CPDP, however, there are factors to consider such as feature selection and data quality. Feature selection is a process of eliminating noisy features from a dataset when developing a predictive model. It increases the performance of the model and reduces the computational cost. In this study, the authors aim at utilizing the stochastic optimization algorithm to select the best feature subset. The stochastic variant of the hill-climbing algorithm is used to search the solution and a decision tree classifier is used to evaluate the solution after each iteration. The dataset is reduced according to the best feature subset and then CPDP performance is evaluated by the Naive Bayes classifier. In most of the prediction results, the proposed method shown the best results and has improved the existing CFS method by 1.5 % in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Convolution Neural Network based Image Denoising: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Presence of noise in medical images leads to loss in the visual information available and may lead to false analysis by medical experts. Major sources include the noise generated due to handheld devices. Recent trend towards low dose imaging also increases the noise in the images. The decrease of noise in medical images is required for higher accuracy. So, Convolution neural network (CNN) are used for the denoising of images. De-noising using CNN based methods is viable and workable. This paper reviews the latest generative adversarial network (GAN) based medical image denoising algorithms. Challenges and future scope are also discussed. This study shall help new researchers to understand the recent trends and algorithms in image denoising for medical images.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Neural Network Controller for PV
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This article presents a sliding mode neural network controller to extract the maximum electricity from a photovoltaic (PV) panel and to acquire the required voltage level from both the PV panel and the battery system. The control law is based on the Lyapunov control function to produce an asymptotically stable system. Changes in irradiance and temperature inject variables into the system, leading in skewed transient and steady-state responses. As a result, a Chebyshev Neural Network is employed in the suggested controller to estimate the solar current, which will fluctuate owing to irradiance and temperature uncertainty. In MATLAB Simulink, the suggested controller is simulated for changes in irradiance and temperature and compared to the conventional PID controller. Based on the outcomes. The data show that the suggested controller has superior transient and steady-state responses than a conventional PID controller.

articleTitle: Systematic review of methods used in text summarization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Context: with the improvement in technology large amount of text data is available on internet on different platforms like twitter, micro blog, Facebook, e- Newspapers, magazines and different information providing websites. Summary is the need of hour as people do not have enough time to go through all the documents manually and get accurate and allusive information. Textual summarization is the process of condensing size of a text document in such a manner that its original meaning is maintained. In time bound situations it is not possible for humans to extract important info manually from bulky volumes of text data that is available on internet. To extract and process such magnanimous data Text summarizers are being developed. Over the period of time Summaries generated by these text summarizers are improved to produce more human oriented summaries.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study in Understanding the Emerging Field of Blockchain Toward Effective Accounting Information Systems in Large Corporations
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Block chain technology is now becoming a demanding technology for large corporations since it benefited the companies more in their accounting and finance fields. This technology could provide a platform for large corporations to store their financial data and track their business assets efficiently. Therefore, by using the technology the firm could make an immense effort in improving its accounting information system which could directly improve the business performance of the large corporation.

articleTitle: Edge Computing Approach For Crowd Sensed Environmental Noise Data Mapping
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Edge computing is a new paradigm in which substantial computing and storage resources are shifted towards the edge of Internet and in proximity to mobile devices or sensors. In the past few years, edge computing has emerged as a promising field for the researchers, academicians and industry persons. In this paper, an existing community sensor network framework has been enhanced with edge support to improve reliability of mobile crowdsourced data in monitoring environmental context like traffic noise pollution. The reliability of data collected in participatory environment is a challenging issue to predict more accurate contextual trends. Proposed solution is potentially enabled to provide more accurate results by filtering out the spurious records at the edge nodes. It significantly cuts the data volume which further helped in attaining faster response time for disbursing the services on demand as compared to previous framework implementation. Experimental study results into low latency with a speed enhancement up to 20% and low jitter while using the community sensing service using the proposed edge-based community sensing framework

articleTitle: Case Machine Learning Experience into Modelling and Simulation to Improve the Efficiency of Construction Engineering Process Management
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The research work has highlighted that the main purpose of this research work is to identify the role of ML (Machine Learning) in simulation modelling and its effect on construction project engineering. In this research, it has been clearly identified that ML achieves the advantages such as risk identification, quality enhancement, and reduction of financial burden. These critical aspects are integrated into the engineering of the construction projects enabled by ML. The present research also shed light on the machine learning technologies for the completion of a construction project with much ease. Lastly, the research consists of some of the data collection methods by which the researcher could appropriately gather the research data and information for the smooth completion of the construction project.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Digital Wallet Transaction Accuracy using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Non-card retail payments, such as direct-from-the-bank programs and E-wallets, have become increasingly common at both brick-and-mortar and online establishments. In recent years, the use of mobile wallets has increased. It relates to any form of computer program that can “learn” on its own beyond the intervention of a human. Machine learning can detect out-of-the-ordinary purchases and flag them as fraudulent by continuously monitoring data in real-time. Machine learning models are being improved by developing new methodologies based on pre-existing models. An example is a hybrid model in which the dataset is under-sampled and over-sampled; for example, credit card transactions. Digital wallets and machine learning are the main focus of this article.

articleTitle: Image Recognition, Recusion Cellular Classification Using Different Techniques and Detecticting Microscopic Deformities
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have turn out to be one of the most advanced approaches trendy distinguishing snapshots in extraordinary fields. White blood cell classification is crucial for diagnosing anaemia, leukaemia, and a variety of other hematologic illnesses. Transfer learning with CNNs is frequently used in biological image categorization. Traditional methods for WBC classification is costly is terms of time and money. In the paper three convolutional neural network architectures are proposed which is based on transfer learning for microscopic image classification and compare the performance of models. The paper compares Transfer learning models like VGG-16, VGG-19, VGG-19 SVM hybrid and AlexNet. VGG-16 gives the best classification performance in comparison. VGG-16 model is which has a train accuracy of 0.9538 and train loss of 0.1322.

articleTitle: ML/DL Based Technologies for Trends Analysis in Plant Stress Phenotyping
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In plant phenotyping, morphological, physiological, and temporal features of plants are quantitatively described as a consequence of the interplay of plant genotypes with their environment. Inside the realm of imaging-based plant phenotypic plasticity, there is a lot of work being made. There are several uses for plant phenotyping, including plant biotechnology research, plant development prediction, abiotic and biotic stresses assessment, crop production, and disease identification in early stages. In terms of understanding the extant bibliography available and latest research advancements in the realm of plant science profiling utilizing plants pictures, primary goal of this study is to present a complete bibliometric analysis. The primary sources for the bibliometric analysis are WoS (Web of Science), Mendeley, Scopus, Google Scholar and Research Gate. Starting with distinct imaging methods being used for plant phenotyping and progressing through distinct image-based plant phenotyping approaches are covered in this bibliometric study. During the period of 2016–19, there has been substantial advancement in the development of plant characterization and stress analysis. Research in plant phenotyping is being led by researchers from the United States, it has been discovered.

articleTitle: Analysis of Materialization View Selection Approaches in Data Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In business Intelligence, accuracy and quick response are the main factors. Materialization view selection plays a crucial role in data warehouse to minimize query processing time. A data warehouse is a collection of multiple sets of queries, selection of the best view among various materialized views is an important task. Materialized view provides fast access to data which is required for decision-making in business. Many authors have suggested and proposed algorithms for materialized view selection that reduce the query computation time. In this paper we have done a systematic survey on various materialization approaches proposed by authors and compared with some parameters such as proposed work, constraints covered, the framework used, and implementation language. For view selection in lattice structure, we proposed an algorithm based on the brute force approach that selects the cuboids having least cost.

articleTitle: Design & Develop a Hybrid Model for Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: There are number of consensus algorithm designed for blockchains, each of which has different prosperity and weaknesses. POA is a novel class of Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus algorithms that are commonly utilised in reality to provide greater performance than traditional byzantine fault tolerance algorithms. Various organizations are moving toward a POA blockchain with Byzantine Fault Tolerance that is more traditional. Without good consensus mechanism it is very hard to prevent the attacks in nodes. Our motive is to research and if we can build the consensus mechanisms with improved algorithms to reduce the risk and attacks on blockchain. We conduct the block generation process and introduce validators voting profiles, which we update, based on validators, voting behaviour, and aggregate blockchain rewards using the POA and POV algorithms. The blockchain has become most popular in recent years; its underlying consensus algorithms have also become a major research focus. This work aimed to studying various consensus algorithm of blockchain to improve the performance of blockchain and to build common and flexible to fit on the most of the platforms.

articleTitle: An Efficient Face Recognition System using Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Face recognition is an AI-based innovation used to find and recognize human appearances in videos and images. Organizations can apply face recognition to many different kinds of fields which may include biometrics, regulation of law, security and individual wellbeing; so as to take observation of individuals in any scenario. Face recognition has advanced from simple vision methods to progress in ML; and further to progressively refined neural networks (ANN) and related advances. It currently assumes an indispensable part as the initial phase in numerous basic applications, including the task of tracking a face. Face recognition is utilized to focus cameras or count the number of individuals present in a particular region. The innovation likewise has showcasing applications, for instance, showing recommended promotions when a specific user is detected.

articleTitle: High Performance Dynamic D Flip Flop based on GNRFET in Double Gate Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: D flip flops may be divided into two categories: static and dynamic flip flops. The dynamic D flip flop is the focus of this research project. The sophisticated design of TSPC is complemented by the configuration of the clock and reset (True single phase clocked). When it comes to performing its function and switching operations, the clock and rest signal use a significant amount of power. The necessity for improvements in the power consumption of the TSPC-based D flip flop creates an appealing study arena in which to pursue further advances in the field. Power consumption rises below 16nm as a result of factors such as DIBL or GIBL, which must be addressed in addition to the process itself. It is suggested in this research to use a novel TSPC-based D Flip Flop with Gates Tied Mode (Multi-Threshold CMOS Logic) sleep signal injection for low-power applications in order to minimise power consumption. This study makes use of low power dependant MOS, such as the GNRFET, in order to alleviate the short channel effects in MOS. The usage of GNRFETs in 16nm technology is the emphasis of this work, which aims to reduce power consumption.

articleTitle: Human age prediction from bone X-ray Scan images by using advanced Deep CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The pace of innovation has enabled the development of computerized systems that do have a variety of uses in the medical field, including pediatrics. Fully automated bone age calculation from left-hand X-ray scanning has been one of the applications, which enables radiologists and pediatricians to make decisions about the skeletal bone growth status of youngsters. However, one of the most difficult aspects of building a computerized system is determining the best technique for getting more accurate estimation, especially in dealing with massive volumes of data. The earlier conventional techniques use hand skeletal bone scans and depend upon an optical examination of the bone picture scans. Conventional approaches like these have a lot of variation within observers, are exceedingly time-consuming, and depend upon an experienced domain expert who assesses skeletal bone age by taking an age annotated bone scan as a reference. Various automatic systems have been employed to reduce such variation. Neural network algorithms such as Convolution neural network (CNN) algorithms and their altered versions are employed to address this, resulting in much more accurate outcomes in significantly less time. Efficient Net is one such architecture that we use in this study. This design substantially replaces the usual Convolution architectures with the considerably more efficient Compound scaled architectures which optimize both accuracy and efficiency and result in drastically decreases in time it takes to generate a trained model. In this article, we have used a collection of left-hand scans provided by the RSNA. The testing results demonstrate a 6.03 month disparity in age in the bone estimation process.

articleTitle: Task Migrations in a Cloud Computing Virtual Machine Using Cauchy Swarm Optimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: By offering virtual resources to end users, cloud computing model is significant to address the difficulty of management of memory. To determine the cloud workloads and subsequently apply the migration algorithm for efficient resource use, several techniques were applied. The procedure is reliant on previous results and just a few steps ahead projections. As a result, the allocation takes longer to process and an essential element allocation of resources is provided in order to allocate and use resources efficiently in response to user requests. Virtualization aims to reduce the expense of running programmes on separate hardware sets. The attribute selection is done using Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and relief. The hybrid Cauchy particle swarm technique is then used to allocate resources based on the selected attribute. The Cluster dataset is used to assess the proposed technique's migrant count and power consumption. The optimal strategic outperforms both the present methodology and the existing method by reducing the energy consumption and the frequency of virtual machine migrations. As a result, for dynamically assigning cloud resources, the proposed ICA and relief-based MCPSO are the best options.

articleTitle: Nomenclature of Diverse Feature Selection in Sentiment Analysis using Machine Learning Techniques: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Sentiment analysis has gained in importance in recent decades as the amount of digital text documents has increased in tandem with the advent of IT. The goal of sentiment analysis in the field of natural language processing (NLP) is to extract positive or negative polarity from social media text. Feature Selection (FS) is important based on critical analysis and efficiently identifying the necessary information for better segregation. The purpose of this research is to assess and compare the performance of several sentiment analysis FS techniques. Several Feature Selection (FS) procedures are studied in order to select the optimal Selection of features from a feature set. Various Machine Learning techniques such as Decision Tree (DT), Naive Bayes (NB), Support Vector Machines (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) and Logistic Regression (LR) are used to train the selected features on the Online Movie Reviews Dataset. According to the findings of the experiments, the proposed system decreases data dimensionality, picks efficient aspects for better analysis

articleTitle: Image Watermarking Based on Discrete Wavelet Transform and Biogeography-Based Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With the growth of information technology has led to a overabundance of multimedia information flowing over network systems. As a result, security duties in connection to multimedia data have been necessitated protection against the disclosure of sensitive data. Watermarking is the technique of inserting data into image to determine its authenticity or the identity. This study presented a BBO-based robust watermarking system. The proposed approach is robust against various attacks. The watermarked image's quality is also taken into account. The simulation results from BBO demonstrate both robustness and image quality. .

articleTitle: Applicability of Association Rule Mining in Recommendation System for Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Nowadays, on visiting a website over the internet or logging into a social media account, it is common to see the recommendation of the products. These products or services shown as advertisements are those which a consumer has ever surfed over the internet or something similar to a past purchase. A recommendation system (RS) is to provide a suggestive description of products or services to a customer based on their past purchasing history. Since this data is humongous, i.e., big data, this approach is used to extract valuable recommendations. But, the challenge here is to provide accurate recommendations to the consumer. In addition to promoting products or services, the consumer will be interested in the recommended products during the next purchase. RS is a crucial method to strengthen the business over e-platform. This paper briefly describes the recommendation system process flow, its different filtering techniques, and the challenges faced in designing the recommendation system. Moreover, the author also discusses the role of Association Rule Mining (ARM) in creating the recommendation system for resolving the issues of the ecommerce domain. Furthermore, the applicability of ARM in RS in past research is also discussed.

articleTitle: A Study on Recognising the Application of Multiple Big Data Technologies and its Related Issues, Difficulties and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The current revolution in data is focused in reshaping the overall knowledge and data which are produced, the manner in which the business is performed and handled in an effective manner. The application of big data offers major insights and opportunities in many industries, moreover it also raises many issues and difficulties which needs to be addressed so as to achieve the overall sustainable development. It has been stated that the critical development of big data can offer real time information which will enable in taking effective action, identify the nature of issues and needs, provide feedback on the critical effectiveness related to the policy. In the present digital environment, the information is collated and saved at a rate which rapidly exceeds the overall range. Currently, nearly 4.5 billion individuals are connected through internet and advanced technologies and this is expected to grow many folds in the next 10 years. However, it can be stated that the big data is still in earlier stage and the domains needs to be reviewed and analysed in an effective manner. The big data presents the overall challenges for the digital earth to process and share the data. The usage of cloud computing offers fundamental support to enhance the challenges through computing resources, storage of data and other aspects. This paper intends to recognised the application of multiple big data technologies and its related issues, difficulties and opportunities, the researchers apply secondary data in collating the data from various sources, the different sources include Google Scholar, ProQuest, published articles in Scopus journals etc.

articleTitle: A Face Spoof Detection in Artificial Neural Networks Using Concepts of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Over the years, technology played an integral role in enhancing eventual data management and also provided effective user satisfaction. Facial biometrics happen to be one of the most effective forms of face spoofing detection which significantly enhance data management to the next level. It is to be seen that photos and videos are the fundamental supplant for this system which essentially complement the data collection, storing and evaluation process. Using this particular technology user are able to utilise their devices for data management by storing and recording their personal photos into the devices. Now, the device with face spoofing detection would essentially identify users based on their historical data in the device database. This also allows user autonomy at the highest level and that is considered as one of the major reasons behind enhanced demand for this system. The research gas used positivism philosophy, deductive approach and descriptive research design. In addition, primary data collection and quantitative data analysis are also used in this research. A total of 50 participants were considered for the survey which is chosen as a primary data collection method. Based on the data analysis and discussion the crucial role of machine learning can be understood in terms of facilitating face spoofing detection.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligent Based Smart Electricity Billing Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: These days, innovation has been created to a progressed level, so clients request frameworks with automation and tall security. The paid ahead-of-time meter is imperative in making the customer have a perception about his or her vitality utilization along with in settling the issues confronting by the utility labour in receiving the perusing of ordinary meter and killing the blunder brought about in bills issuance. These inquiries about objectives to upgrade a current routine vitality meter coordinated with paid ahead of time framework and security system. The outlined paid ahead of time meter encompasses a Raspberry pi 3B+, customary vitality meter, GSM component, current measuring device, and hand-off. The proposed model encompasses two parts: GSM innovation and overcurrent security, while GSM innovation is utilized for transmission and stock up reason; overcurrent assurance is done with a current sensor and hand-off working together.

articleTitle: Deep Learning in Object Oriented Software Engineering: A Case Of Stability
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The software engineering stages assisted by means of deep learning to know due to the variety of SE responsibilities, it is vital to perceive the present SE duties assisted through deep learning, given that it supports practitioners locate the plausible to leverage deep learning knowledge of in their personal glitches. A Stability estimation framework for OO blueprint maintainability angle has been deliberate on this paper using deep learning. The evolved framework correlates the item orientated blueprint traits with maintainability and additionally correlates maintainability with Stability. No such framework has been current in the literature overview that quantifies software program Stability of OO blueprint through taking maintainability into attention using deep learning. The framework bridges the gap amongst item orientated blueprint traits, maintainability and Stability. Framework measures and improves the maintainability of software program blueprint on the blueprint degree of software program improvement lifestyles cycle, maximum massive to a dependable cease product. Stability and maintainability estimation fashions were proposed through the use of the evolved framework. Stability estimation version has been formulated which takes item orientated blueprint traits into attention and proposed Stability estimation fashions take maintainability in attention for enumerating stability of object oriented blueprint.

articleTitle: Bees-Algorithm for parameters identification of PV Models
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: An appropriate circuit model using a Bees Algorithm (BA) for predicting and evaluating photovoltaic (PV) module performance is developed. The BA simulation model is capable of computing the electrical parameters which are usually not supplied by manufacturers' datasheets with commercial PV modules. BA is employed here for the identification of optimum parameters of the PV module (photo-watt PWP201) for both single diode (SD), and double diode (DD) models. The photovoltaic module is tested using a standard PV characterization system to acquire current-voltage curves. Additionally, b experimental results from the I- V characteristic curves are used as the input parameters for the simulation. The results show that the simulation model can significantly reduce root mean square error of photovoltaic modules between the measured and calculated data. A comparative study of the simulation technique and other techniques from the literature demonstrates the functionality and applicability of the BA for PV systems. The novel technique also presents a promising feature for detecting faults which could be crucial for condition monitoring and fault diagnosis in future PV energy systems.

articleTitle: Optimizing Image Fusion Using Wavelet Transform Based Alternative Direction Multiplier Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Image fusion is the method of merge two or more photographs in such a manner that the best features of each are preserved. When a panchromatic picture is combined with multispectral data, the intended outcome is an image that has both the panchromatic image's spatial quality and resolution as well as the multispectral image's spectral resolution and quality. Standard digital fusion methods are generally successful in infusing spatial detail into multispectral data, but the colour information often distorted in the process. Wavelet transformations have been used in picture fusion for over a decade, and there has been a lot of study done on them. The findings of a variety of wavelet-based image fusion strategies are examined in this research, which includes a framework of Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) and Undecimated Discrete Wavelet Transform (UDWT) theory, as well as the Alternative Direction Multiplier Method (ADMM) fusion approach. Wavelet-based schemes have been proven to perform better than conventional schemes in general, especially when it comes to minimising colour distortion. Standard approaches combined with wavelet transformations yield better outcomes than standard methods or basic wavelet-based methods alone. More advanced models for infusing detailed description can enhance the outcomes of wavelet-based approaches; however, these schemes frequently have higher set-up requirements.

articleTitle: Gesticulation Recognition System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With the growth in globalization and emphasis on educational advancements, we want to make sure that no one should face any kind of hindrance regardless of one's incapability. We are aiming to build a web application in order to overcome the disabilities of deaf and dumb people to make sure they don't feel like straggling behind the rest of the world, as education defines one's personality. This project will not only be used in academic fields but also in day-to-day life as well because communication is a must to survive. This web application will be reading users' hand gestures and after analysis, it will convert that sign into the text as well as speech format so they can communicate easily with everyone around them. This gesture conversion that we are building is only limited to the English language as of now, but we will be looking forward to expanding its linguistic basket to have multiple language conversions in the near future.

articleTitle: Medical Image Classification for Disease Prediction with the AID of Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The need and requirements of machine learning are increasing day by day in the field of medical image classification. This research paper illustrates the relevance of machine learning in making successful detection of medical diseases by classifying the medical images in an organised manner. In this context, a brief evolution of machine learning has been provided here. Besides the growth of machine learning in the field of healthcare is presented neatly in this research paper. The literature part clearly describes the previous work in the respective field and the mechanism of machine learning. In parallel to it, a brief description of how the research has been conducted is also presented in this research paper. In this context, the survey conduction among 67 people is mentioned here. Besides analysis and interpretation of the data which are gathered from the survey is present here. The research paper also talks about the flaws of machine learning which have misguided several medical diagnosis processes in the recent past. The dynamics of ML and the relevant results were presented in the discussion and finding parts. At last, a conclusive summarisation has been presented here to provide an overall idea about the image classification process by integrating ML in the modern medical treatment process.

articleTitle: CardioVascular Disease Detection uing Power Transforamtion and GradientBoosting Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases are a set of blood vessel and heart problems. A setup of fatty plaques, one of the most major reasons is damage to the under cover of the blood vessels that serve the cardio and brain. So, given the current treatments, the best thing is to catch it early and get it underhand. Because there are so many people who suffer from this condition, there is a lot of data on the topic. This enables scientists to use information examination strategies to study this topic. This work data utilizes from IEEE data port, which has 70,000 cases with each having 12 features. There were three methods used: namely Logistic Regression, AdaBoosting, and GradientBoosting Classifier. Using these techniques, we were able to attain the maximum accuracy of 95 percent on all approaches.

articleTitle: Maintainability Quantification Model of Object Oriented Software: An Innovative Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Quantifying software's maintainability prompt in the system development life cycle particularly at design and development time is a benchmark of fundamental importance to object-oriented designers, computer programmer as well as object-oriented software quality controllers. Early quantification of software maintainability, completely at design time helps programmers to increase their software designs beforehand the implementation starts. Practitioners as well as software developers regularly stated that maintainability evaluation must be scheduled at object-oriented design stage of system improvement life cycle. This research paper recommends a maintainability quantification model that workings at design stage of project improvement lifecycle. Additionally, statistical investigation is implemented to rationalize the correspondence of maintainability by means of its foremost donors Modularity as well as Reusability. The proposed model has been validated by means of experimental evaluation. In conclusion, it includes the firsthand validation of the proposed maintainability Quantification method.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Smart Home Applying Natural Language Processing Using Internet of Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Internet of Thigs is mainly considered as the key technology tools which enables in connecting many devices through the use of internet, this has enabled in overall exchange of data and information, support in receiving the instruction and enable in acting upon it in an effective manner. With the advent of IoT, many devices are connected to the internet which enable in assisting the individuals to operate the devise virtually, share data and program required actions. This study is focused in understanding the key determinants of creating smart homes by applying natural language processing (NLP) through IoT. The major determinants considered are Integrating voice understanding into devices; Ability to control the devices remotely and support in reducing the energy bills. The present study focuses in sourcing the data from both sources and information are collected through the usage of questionnaire and the information are quantitatively applied through 5-point Likert scale. The researchers use extensive data analysis tools using AMOS for understanding the path diagram using structural equation model.

articleTitle: Deep learning Support Vector Machine Application Management for Prediction Binding Elements
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Considering that alkaline earth metals particles are key protein binding partners in the biological system, predicting their binding positions is of critical importance. The study objectives in this work are the compounds of the metal ions Mg2+ or Ca2+. Deep learning models' algorithms are utilized to estimate the binding locations of proteins depending on the distinctive properties of protein sequencing, amino acids, physicochemical qualities of amino acids, or projected structure data. The predictions outcomes obtained via fivefold cross-validation are superior to those obtained by the Ion-seq approach because the hyper-parameters of the deep learning model have been optimized. As a bonus, the under-sampling information treatment approach is used to properly evaluate and validate the efficiency of the presented models, as well as the predictions findings acquired via independently testing are superior to those produced by the SVM classifier.

articleTitle: MTN: Tranformation from Mixed Dataset into Pure Numeric Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Sometimes in real world problems we obtain mixed dataset having numerical as well as categorical attributes. Researcher and analysis while need the suitable format of dataset to use or develop any of the machine learning algorithm. This paper proposed a transformation method to transform the Mixed inTo pure Numeric dataset (MTN). This transformation method is based on similarity among the categorical and numeric attribute values.

articleTitle: CheXVGG: A deep neural network for multi-disease classification of chest-xray images using transfer learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Multi disease classification is a thoroughly investigated research topic in the healthcare field. Various deep neural networks (DNNs) have been proposed for multi-disease classifications and have achieved significant results. Most of the existing DNN solutions use low-resolution images for training, limiting performance. This work introduces a deep neural network that takes high-resolution chest radiograph images as input and classifies these into 14 common chest diseases. The proposed model, CheXVGG, comprises the convolutional, maxpool blocks, which mirror VGG19 architecture and fully connected layers with embedded dropout layers and a sigmoid layer. The network is end-to-end trained using a large public dataset, ChestXray14. We have empirically shown that although it is computationally expensive to use the high-resolution image for training, it improves the network's performance. The speculative study of the experiments performed shows that CheXVGG has achieved significant performance in multi-disease classification.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation in Understanding the Recent Advancements in the Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence for Better Application in the Future
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is refers as a simulation of the human intelligence through computer programmed that can mimic the action of human for making a system more efficient and adaptive to the realistic world. The collaboration of machine learning and AI has brought a huge development in the digital technology and business operation by implementing high level of coding and algorithm. With the help of AI, machine can learn new things automatically by creating and analysing patterns, that effective makes a work done faster. In this context, this research has shed light on the recent developments in AI and block chain technologies. This factor further may helpful for the business vertical in changing the way of doing work in the future.

articleTitle: A Critical Investigation in the Approach Suggested to Maintain the Quality of Service in Wireless Ad Hoc Network Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Quality of service essentially refers to the set of technologies that essentially connects a network of high-priority applications by controlling network traffic. Effective integration of quality of service effectively enhances the quality of network distribution which is considered to be an essential element for network distribution and data flow both. Thus ensuring effective maintenance of quality of service plays an essential role in improving user experience. On the other hand, ad hoc networks essentially allow connecting multiple devices at a time without having a single central point of the network. This essentially helps connect devices easily. The concerned research used positivism research philosophy, deductive approach and descriptive research design to research necessary research outcome. In addition, secondary data collection is used to collect proper information related to research topic. Upon considering the discussion based on data analysis, the need for quality of service emerged to be essential for wireless ad hoc networks in terms of facilitating network distribution and maintaining data flow to the devices. On the other hand, effective integration of “best effort” and resource reservation can be the significant ways to maintain quality of service for wireless ad hoc networks.

articleTitle: A new enhancement of the k-NN algorithm by Using an optimization technique
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Of a number of ML (Machine Learning) algorithms, k-nearest neighbour (KNN) is among the most common for data classification research, and classifying diseases and faults, which is essential due to frequent alterations in the training dataset, in which it would be expensive using most methods to construct a different classifier every time this happens. Here, a novel KNN classification approach is put forward using the Bayesian Optimization Algorithm (BOA) for optimisation. This paper seeks to make classification more accurate and suggest alterations of nearest neighbour K value to use information about dataset structure and the similarity measure of distance. The findings of experimental work based on the University of California Irvine (UCI) repository datasets in general shows improved performance of classifiers compared with conventional KNN and give greater reliability without a significant time cost to speed.

abstract: Machine learning models are employed widely in the classification, diagnosis, and prediction of various health disorders. This paper does a comparison study of the popular traditional data classification models with ensemble and hybrid classification models developed and applied in diagnosis and prediction of one of the most frequently occurring endocrinal illness, viz Thyroid disorders. According to a survey conducted in India in 2016, disorders of thyroid gland are increased in an exponential rate in Indian subcontinent. Approximately 1 in every 10 adults suffer from thyroid disorders like hypothyroidism, a condition of hormonal imbalance in which the thyroid produces too little hormone for proper functioning of human body. This condition is more common in women of child-bearing age. Some agents that unfavourably affect the thyroid performance are stress, trauma, infection etc. Various machine learning algorithms popularly applied are Regression models, Bayesian classifier, k Nearest Neighbours, Decision Tree induction, Support Vector Machine, and they are employed in Thyroid disorder prediction researches and tools. Nowadays, ensemble models have replaced simple classification techniques in this area. This paper provides an exclusive comparative study of standard traditional classification models with novel Ensemble models used in the classification and prediction of thyroid disorders.

AI is a game-changer in terms of disease diagnosis speed and accuracy. articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Fuzzy Logic Controller for PV Battery System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This paper describes the adaptive sliding mode fuzzy logic controller to obtain maximum power from Solar panel and to get desired grid voltage from the battery system. The combination of solar panels and batteries is connected to a single grid called the DC microgrid. In a sliding mode controller with fuzzy logic, solar panels are coupled with a boost converter produce the more power, and batteries are linked to a DC bi-directional converter to provide the grid with the constant voltage. The varying solar current and the varying battery voltage are approximated using the fuzzy logic in adaptive sliding mode fuzzy logic controller. Tuning the control laws done in correspondence with Lyapunov stability analysis to achieve asymptotically stable system. Further, there are a total number of five membership functions that approximate the uncertainty which will be used to design the complex rules. The robustness of the proposed controller is ensured by comparing the sliding mode fuzzy logic controller with the conventional PID controller. For a wide range of variations in the irradiance and grid voltage from simulation results, it is obvious that the proposed controller shows the emphasized transient response with less settling time and overshoot and steady-state response with minimum mistake and high efficiency as compared with conventional PID controller.

abstract: Machine learning (ML), a form of artificial intelligence, allows software systems to become better at predicting events without having to be explicitly programmed (AI). This study provides an overview of metallic biomaterials and potential to machine learning that are frequently utilised in medical procedures and procedures using metal.

articleTitle: Key Management using Lagrange Interpolation for Wireless Communications

abstract: Security is one of the major concerns that must be addressed with a variety of preventative methods. The fundamental goal of security is to transfer sensitive data in a secure, unreadable format that can only be accessible by authorized parties. A plethora of encrypting and decrypting algorithms are available; nevertheless, the challenge is to generate a secure key that is difficult to break. This paper proposed a polynomial-based key generating mechanism. Mathematically, whenever a polynomial is generated through the interpolation method, it is unique and is challenging to guess without known data points. In this paper, the data points are generated employing a random generator to provide more randomness to the algorithm. Furthermore, it compares the proposed algorithm with the existing one.

abstract: Steganography, also known as the science of invisible communication, is one of the ways for secretly transmitting information., which generally focuses on ways to conceal the presence of the conveyed message. If this is accomplished effectively, the message will not draw the attention of eavesdroppers or attackers. Information may be buried in various embedding materials, known as carriers, using steganography. Images, music, video, and text files can all be utilised as carriers. The research's goal is to employ a picture file as a carrier. As a result, a taxonomy of extant picture steganographic techniques has been defined. These techniques are analyzed and graded not just in order to optimally to conceal information in image files, but also in terms of the amount of information that can be hidden and their resilience to various image processing assaults.
