articleTitle: Analysis of Large Array with Phased Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This paper gives an overview to design array antennas by using phased array antennas. Antenna arrays of large scale have a variety of applications which include massive MIMO applications for 5G technology. Using a Phased sub array it improves gain, directivity bandwidth of an antenna, performance of link reliability and data rate. It presents the design and analysis of antenna arrays of large scale. It is simple and more efficient with implementation of techniques by phased sub arrays to improve the analysis of array antennas with large scale [1]. Repeating small sub arrays multiple times, antenna arrays of large scale can be designed. Using MATLAB software, a sub array is designed for 2x2 (4 elements) and 4x4(16 elements) is analyzed with various parameters like bandwidth, gain and directivity. The results are analyzed with array elements, sidelobes, directivities and High-power bandwidth. Using these results design large array with sub phased array.

articleTitle: Optimal Resource Utilization Inprecisionagriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Precision Agriculture is a modern improvised online farming management concept. It is otherwise named as Internet based farming or Site specific crop management. The field parameters are observed, measured and monitored through wireless technology. It provides a Decision Support System for whole Agricultural management. The main focus of PA is optimal utilization of input resources and getting better productivity and high yield. Various machine learning approaches are used for optimizing the resource utilization among them Enhanced Learning Machine technique is used mostly and it is found that 86% accuracy achieved in regression with artificial neural network proposed by Priyadarshini A. et.al. In this modernized technology, Wireless sensor nodes play a major role in collecting different types of soil parameters and uploaded at base station through gateway and Radio Frequency plays major role in communication. The data must be perfectly monitored for proper agri-decision. ELM is about Empirical Risk Minimization technique and its learning process needs only a single iteration. It avoids multiple iteration and local minimization. This technique is widely applied in various fields due to better generalization ability, robustness, control features with fast learning rate.

articleTitle: Social Media Sentiment Analysis of Stock Market on Tweets
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Sentiment categorization is utilized in today's world to analyze social media data about the stock market and estimate its future stock movement. We investigated the possible influence of “public sentiment” on “market trends” using sentiment analysis and machine learning concepts. Due to the enormous number of components involved, such as economic situations, political events, and other environmental factors that may affect the stock price, stock price prediction is an exceedingly complicated and challenging process. Because of these considerations, evaluating a single factor's influence on future pricing and trends is challenging. As more individuals spend time online, the popularity and impact of numerous social media platforms has skyrocketed in recent years. Twitter is one such social media tool that has exploded in popularity. Twitter is a terrific place to stay up to speed on current societal trends and perspectives. The “Twittersphere” is a melting pot that supports diverse viewpoints, emotions, and trends, and it has the potential to be a crucial influencer in influencing and shaping perceptions.

articleTitle: A Review on Smart Cities with Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Smart City is an evolving model targeting at vindicating the encounters upraised due to the constant spread and growth. Merger of telecommunication technologies and revolution in field of info, the visualisation of the ‘SC’ is rapidly converting to realism. City administrations and managements in a plenty of countries are exploiting on these developments to improve citizens lives and to upsurge sustainability and competence. ICT “Information and Communication Technologies” is the permitting machinery for revamping. These know-hows harvest enormous capacities of data known as BD “Big Data”. As a result of fast growth of such data, results require to be planned and delivered for handling and extraction of value and information from these datasets. Additionally, the main project owners require being capable to achieve valued acumens from this type of wide-ranging and swiftly varying data, stretching via routine trades to consumer interfaces and social networking data. This type of value may be delivered utilizing BDA “Big Data Analytics” that is solicitation of progressive analytics methods on BD. It is literature's methodical analysis on BDA in SCs. Some of the most important research findings have been presented by us in data analytics area. The aim of our work is to explore few of the various analytics approaches and techniques that may be used for BD. We used a systematic literature review on BDA systems in smart cities to address these questions.

articleTitle: An Analytical Study on the influence of using Trimmed Gait Energy Images for Human Gait Biometrics using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Gait based human recognition is founded on the principle that every human being has a distinctive style of walking. With the rise in the use of video surveillance devices, gait is one of the most convenient biometrics to use, in forensics. This paper is an analytical study of the effect of using trimmed Gait Energy Images (GEI) for Human Recognition using different deep learning techniques. Gait energy images are a spatiotemporal, silhouette-based representation of the human gait. GEIs from the CASIA B Multiview dataset was used to build two other sets of data by subtracting the upper body Deep learning and transfer learning techniques including Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) and VGG16 algorithms had been implemented to carry out the recognition. Results showed that the performance of the model using upper body images gives a greater accuracy than the lower body images. It has also been observed that the accuracy of recognition provided by the upper part of the body is almost the same as that achieved by the whole body, which brings forth the idea that the upper part of the body is the most pertinent in Human Identification using Gait as a biometric.

articleTitle: A Review on Flywheel Energy Storage System in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: We'll learn how to build a small flywheel energy storage device which can store energy in a form of kinetic energy and afterwards convert it back to electrical power as needed. If passive bearings in flywheel is sustained by having a radial permanent magnet. It is possible to rotate freely without making touch with moving parts when using a permanent magnet passive bearing. Complete magnetic levitation is achieved by the use of a series of voice coil actuators to provide axial stability. A toroidally wound BLDC motor, which would be more efficient and also has a lower added negative radial flexibility than conventional motors, is utilised to power both motoring and generating. The energy storage capacity of the micro flywheel has been maximised via the development of this new storage technology. From this work, a micro flywheel energy storage is utilised by illustrate the design equation and optimum design approach for the system's modules.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the MFO tuned PID controller based autonomous power system
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The research deals with the different optimization techniques employed to develop the various parameters which are adjustable for an autonomous energy system. The terminal voltage of the generator has been controlled by using classical proportional-derivative-integral (PID) controller whose parameters have been tuned by different optimization techniques such as moth flame optimization (MFO), genetic algorithm (GA), seeker optimization algorithm (SOA) and whale optimization technique (WOA). Comparative analysis is performed in this research task by comparing all the techniques implemented for the optimization of PID controller installed in the system.

articleTitle: To Understand the Critical Measures of Enhanced Security in Cloud Computing for Creating Better Data Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Today, the use of cloud computing for better data protection has been increased to a great extent. One of the essential reasons for using cloud computing as a means of data protection is that users can easily access relevant data with the proper security protocols. However, various sectors such as healthcare, finance, automotive, education, manufacturing, etc. have experienced a lot of challenges regarding large and confidential data protection in the past few decades. With the advent of Cloud-computing in recent times, all the issues related to data security and information protection have been easier than before. Researchers have conducted an effective quantitative data collection approach by performing primary analysis through surveys. With a probability sampling technique, researchers have asked around 60 participants from different industrial fields about their opinions regarding the research topic. As per research findings around 60% of people have supported that cloud computing is essential for maximizing data protection. Around 30% people agreed with the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$24 \times 7$</tex> information monitoring and data encryption challenges can be solved with cloud computing. On the other hand, around 10% of participants have placed their positive opinion over the error reduction in data protection by using cloud computing. Researchers in this particular research paper are going to explain the importance of using cloud computing as a data security tool. In order to create better data protection systems across various industrial departments, cloud computing can be used in the future research as well.

articleTitle: Reliability Concern of IoT Based Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: IoT based Monitoring Systems are getting much attention today almost in all sectors like Engineering, Medical, Transportation, Agricultural etc. Monitoring systems are integrated to ensure more security to the systems under vigilance. Hence, ensuring high reliability of such system is utmost required. It is well known that, IoT monitoring system execute its function, when following subsystems like sensor, converters, micro controllers, actuators, communication systems and associated devices perfectly work together. Here, authors want to showcase the various reliability concerns and challenges of such systems. Also it is extended to model the reliability of subcomponents based on its functional responsibility.

articleTitle: The Critical Role of Implementing Blockchain Technology in Enhancing Financial Risk Management in the Cryptocurrency Market
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The purpose of this research work is to understand the ways and benefits of block chain in mitigating the risks associated with crypto currencies. The literature review has demonstrated that risks associated with it are related to regulations and cyber attacks. The findings of this research have explained that algorithm-based learning and efficiency peer to peer framework has helped to mitigate these risks.

articleTitle: The Emerging Role of Integrating Artificial Intelligence (Ai) in the Software Defined Network for Effective Traffic Prediction using Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Traffic technology can be improved using SDN as it enhances overall performance, SDN provides flow control capabilities, distributed access restrictions, traffic analysis and conditions and more. SDN offers many benefits over the past. Cultural network design, which provides better planning and control from a global network perspective, is also important for analyzing network status and performance requirements. The next thing is that SDN provides better flexibility as data quality is significantly improved, in order to increase the efficient allocation of network resources…. Flow control provides the ability to address issues related to transportation costs and data quality, but tolerance limits refers to the ability to detect the cause of network failures and respond quickly, and traffic analysis plays an important role in identifying network failures. The TE supports in monitoring the network parameters including the utilisation of the bandwidth, however the critical element is to generate the data related to the utilisation, this also enable in monitoring and traffic analysis in an effective manner. It also warns of congestion or problems in the system. There are two main ways that OFF flow meter data can be collected, the first is to collect the associated controls and then distribute the necessary equipment. Nowadays, various technologies and monitoring technologies have been used to understand the overall performance of the device. The application of AI techniques tends to offer better tacking the aggregation issue and provide better and flexible approach which can be used to manage the network traffic in an effective manner.

articleTitle: Comparison of Machine Learning Algorithms for Predicting Chronic Kidney Disease
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Early detection and characterization of chronic renal disease are crucial to ensure that patients receive the best possible treatment. This study uses data mining techniques to uncover hidden information about patients. The outcomes of using the Random Forest, Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, XGBoost, LGBM Classifier, GaussianNB, KNeighbors Classifier, and XGBRF classifier have been compared. In our study, we demonstrate that Random Forest and XGBoost algorithms are more effective in classifying and predicting the severity level of chronic kidney disease

articleTitle: Strategic Evaluation of Implementing Artificial Intelligence Towards Shaping Entrepreneurial Development During Covid- 19 Outbreaks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) shape the business enterprises and enable in realizing enhanced growth and development. It has been observed that the application of AI enables in influencing the organizational culture in an effective manner thereby enhancing the working environment which will lead to better productivity and output. The implementation of AI support in enhancing the entrepreneurial aspects through enhancing the cultural and ethical aspects and influence better decision making, create new business practices which will harness human capital and effective leadership capabilities. It has been regarded that the implementation of AI possesses the overall ability to quickly understand the business process and address the issues efficiently for superior performance. The companies which apply AI enable in enhancing the service delivery, understand customer requirements, forecast the business patterns for realizing growth and development. It has been regarded that the current organizational environment is focusing in implementing effective and dynamic capabilities which will influence in attaining growth and success in an effective manner Therefore, the overall success to these initiatives is mainly based on the changes in the internal and external environment, and culture & ethical aspects are being applied in the organizational context. The application of effective leadership support in enhancing the organizational culture and which will create better entrepreneurial aspect for effective performance. This study is focused in addressing the critical strategic evaluation of implementing Artificial Intelligence towards shaping Entrepreneurial Development during COVID- 19 Outbreaks. In its pure essence it is focused in understanding the critical nature of culture and ethical aspect which will enable in creating better programs and support entrepreneurial spirit.

articleTitle: Analysis of Multiple Toxicities Using ML Algorithms to Detect Toxic Comments
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Toxic Comment Classification is a classification problem that needs to be addressed these days. People can expresstheir thoughts on the internet via social media platforms. Hence itis important to set up some guidelines, which address the kind of information that is allowed to be posted. Hence The study of comments and their classification is necessary. The main aim of the following project is to understand whether the followingcomment falls under the toxic or nontoxic category by using multiple machine learning techniques. The following study uses 6 different traits, with the help of □ vectorization a dictionary will be created out of known vocabulary(Dataset) to train the ML model. Since Multiple Traits are presentthe ML model has to get trained multiple times against each trait.This helps us to identify, which algorithm performs best in identifying multiple types of toxicities. It was identified that the Random Forest algorithm performed well against all types of traitswhich gave us a good accuracy of 85% with a precision of 91%. During the preliminary research, it was concluded that most of theresearch which was revolving around the topic was limited to Demographic/local Languages. We tried identifying a classifier for the English language.

articleTitle: An Ergonomic model of Commode Assistive Wheelchair for Disable Persons
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Old age, physically disabled, persons suffering from different diseases always require help for their routine activities. This situation becomes even more difficult for the patients as well as for the relatives/ caretaker of the patient in case patient is having multiple injuries/ lower limbs are not working and or patient is too much fatty. Some products have been already developed and are available in the market where a commode cavity is attached beneath the chair with the chair. Some chairs with inbuilt commode assembly and mechanism for self-cleaning are also available. The main objective of this study is to design a low-cost commode assistive wheelchair. Testing of the chair has been done in both simulated and real environment. To find the effectiveness of the chair a descriptive analysis was conducted. The results statistically proved that in terms of maintenance, weight, chances of genitalinjuries and design this product is an effective solution for the old age and disabled. Total 25 persons have been involved to conduct the study. The proposed solution provides advance characteristics and user-friendly features in comparison to existing solutions and provides ease of defecation.

articleTitle: Detection of Abnormal Driving Behavior Detection Using ADBDConvolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Monitoring anomalous driving behaviours in real time is a critical component of increasing vehicle safety. To improve driver behaviour and driving practisesin order to avoid car accidents. The use of vision-based anomalous driving behaviour detection is growing in popularity because it is fundamental to the safety of drivers and passengers in cars and is a crucial step toward attaining automated driving at this level at this time. This difficult detection task can be greatly aided by recent advancements in deep learning approaches, such as advanced deep learning models' remarkable generalisation power and the large volumes of video clips required for completely training these data-driven deep learning models. To wrap off the research work, novel deep learning-based models, inspired by the newly developed and widely used fully connected convolutional network named the Abnormal Driving Behavior Detection (ADBD Net), are presented.

Author Keywords: Convolution Neural Networks.Monitoring Driving and Deep learning

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Internet of Things (IOT) Sustained Integrity System Services with Data Management Based ON Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) and Machine Learning (ML) are recent trends in huge data management. Traditionally, data management was carried out by humans where big data collection, analysis and acquisition were solely done by humans. However, IoT and ML have enabled machines rather than humans to collect big data, analyse them and develop a new business model. It has shown huge success in industry 4.0; however, during the management of big data, large-scale companies encountered certain issues. These include, lack of effective training leads to less accuracy in data management, security issues during cloud computing and security issues in blockchain as well. Therefore, this study has explained the ways to improve big data management through ML and to enhance the security of blockchain. A primary survey was carried out with 50 respondents who provided their responses to certain questions related to big data management solutions and blockchain security. Findings showed that providing training to the workers and using guidelines/policies in blockchain can increase the data management accuracy and can improve the security in cloud computing, respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Line Segmentation Methods for Historical Manuscripts
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Historical manuscripts are rich source of knowledge about culture, civilization, political system, ancient science and mathematical research and also represent the cultural as well as the religious heritage of the country. Handwritten Text Recognition is the technique to convert the handwritten document into a machine-understandable format. Line segmentation of the document is a very crucial step of the HTR. Last few decades, researchers have invented many algorithms for the segmentation of handwritten or printed documents but these algorithms are not directly applied on these manuscripts due to the presence of the touching lines, uneven space between lines, touching characters, slant, stains, different font size and writing styles, decoration, noise, wrinkles, faded ink, ink bleed through, stitches, rust etc. These issues make the segment process bit complicated. In this paper, an attempt is made to report various traditional and learning based line segmentation methods along with their performances.

articleTitle: An Improved Reputation Based Approach for Malicious Node Detection System in Manet
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The current stady is confined in proposing a reputation based approach for detecting malicious activity where past activities of each node is recorded for future reference. It has been regarded that the Mobile ad-hoc network commonly called as (MANET) is stated as the critical wireless network on the mobile devices using self related assets. Security considered as the main challenge in MANET. Many existing work has done on the basis of detecting attacks by using various approaches like Intrusion Detection, Bait detection, Cooperative malicious detection and so on. In this paper some approaches for identifying malicious nodes has been discussed. But this Reputation based approach mainly focuses on sleuthing the critcal nodes on the trusted path than the shortest path. Each node will record the activity of its own like data received from and Transferred to information. As soon as a node update its activity it is verified and a trust factor is assigned. By comparing the assigned trust factor a list of suspicious or malicious node is created..

articleTitle: The Implementation of Big Data With Cloud and Edge Computing in Enhancing the Smart Grid Information Processes Through Sem Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: It is not possible to handle and huge amounts of data using present software programmes and personal computers owing to a lack of appropriate computing power. Manufacturing organisations must either employ Cloud computing technology or engage in more current techniques including Edge Computing technology if they are to compete in the global market. The SEM model is used to examine the Smart Grid Information Processes in this article. Furthermore, it is proposed that the research contributes to the expansion of experience in the discipline of smart meters and Internet of Things acceptability, despite the fact that this is a very rare topic.

articleTitle: A Multiband Antenna For IoT Applications with Two Narrow-Single Wideband Including sub-6GHz 5G NR, WLAN and UWB-X Bands
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this work, a multiband antenna including two narrowband and single wideband is investigated. The proposed antenna is printed on Rogers RTDuroid 5880 substrate. The radiating patch is bifurcated as combination of patch and rectangular stub providing multiband. The proposed antenna comprises of compact size of 25×25 mm2 resulting in sub-6GHz 5G, WLAN and UWB-X bands. The proposed antenna is also analyzed by studying surface current density distribution and impedance. The far-field results offers good 2-D radiation patterns in all the three bands which makes it compatible for applications in hand-held devices and IoT.

articleTitle: Voltage-mode Low-Pass Filter Using FTFNTA
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In recent literature a voltage-mode (VM) low-pass filter (LPF) was reported. But it requires two Four Terminal Floating Nullor Transconductance Amplifiers (FTFNTAs) and a floating capacitor. To reduce the need for active elements and floating capacitor, two new topologies are presented for the development of VM LPF consisting of single FTFNTA, two grounded capacitors and two/three resistors. One of the designs requires all grounded passive elements; hence the presented design is feasible for IC realization. The sensitivity analyses of both the designs are also discussed. To test the feasibility of both the designs Pspice simulation is carried-out with 180 nm process parameters. Monte Carlo analysis is also performed.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based recommendation system Using User-Item Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Electronic commerce, or e-commerce, is the activity of trading services and commodities through the internet. Identifying the item that the consumer may buy from the enormous number of possibilities accessible to solve this difficulty is now one of the key difficulties encountered by most E-commerce businesses. Recommender systems have been implemented. Recommender systems (RS) are systems that collect information from users about their preferences and allow them to make decisions from the available options. Today, various recommender systems are growing with the advent of web-based information. As you can see from various articles, such recommender systems are used in a variety of industries, from simple objects to more sophisticated objects.RS has gained popularity in the previous decade, particularly in the realm of E-Commerce and related sectors. This report aims to identify recent developments as well as their potential for improvement. It is intended to elaborate on a number of points. And also work more on user-item based recommendation. These types of user-item based recommendation will be more effective in fashion area.

articleTitle: Quantum Cryptography with Photon Polarization and Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this modern era, most cryptographic algorithms work on a basic principle to split integers into their primes. But the problem is that mathematics is also evolving at a very fast pace along with computing power so it is now more vulnerable to decryption, for example, one-way functions can be easily reversed along with factoring big integers. So, to solve this issue Quantum Physics gets involved with cryptography which further led to the concept of Quantum Cryptography. Quantum Cryptography is one of the fastest-growing technology in computer science. So, this paper is more focused on Quantum Cryptography technology and how it can be used to make our modern cryptographic era safeguard from top to bottom procedure related to getting more secure Key-transfer. This paper's scope is to cover all the vulnerabilities of the current cryptosystem, the uses of this technology in the real-world scenario, the limitations when used in real-world situations, and also what will be the future of Quantum Cryptography and the path it should head towards. We have tried to use tools and protocols which is modified to use the quantum key transfer by which the user's using it will not have access to each other's personal information, instead of sharing any private or public key in advance, we transfer an unordered quantum transmission which consists of a very little flash of polarized light.

articleTitle: Proposed Parameters for Simulation and Analysis of Handover, Coverage, and Capacity for UMTS
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A soft handover process is common happen in communication, take place when the mobile position is in the interfere concealment place of two neighbor cells. The work of this paper presents modeling access seam on the customer Equipment/Mobile peripheral for the radio interface with 3GPP UMTS standards. Therefore, the main objective of this paper is focus on how the data traffic in both upper link and downer link working in each Medium Access Control/Radio Link Control sub-layer. In this simulation, The OPNET optimization software is used. The simulation is taken three Scenarios, the first scenario is to analyze the soft handover of user in the network when send and revived data in the uplink and downlink from the BTS (node-B) and explain the several cells in UE’ s Active Set and explain the cells are added into and removed during the simulation. The second scenario is explain the effect of the Node _ B coverage area and show the effect of the maximum path loss in network and showing the maximum path loss increase the coverage decrease. The last scenario describe the effect of the Node_B Capacity, when the users move towards the node _B the total transmitted load in the cell will increase and overall uplink productivity of the Node B will increase and uplink transmission power increase this effect that the capacity. the result of the possibility a customer which is soft handover and explain the impact of it, the graph is explained the capacity and the coverage of system.

articleTitle: Smart Motion Sensor Design for Energy Saving and Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Energy is a scared resource! Optimizing energy usage is a key attribute of our daily lives. The Pyroelectric Infrared (PIR) sensor accomplishes this goal in multiple folds. First, it optimizes energy usage by sensing user presence and applying control action to turn off appliances when human or animal absence is noticed. Second, it also provides constant surveillance against human or animal motion. Third, it is a cost-effective alternative to live camera surveillance. Finally, it is privacy-protective monitoring. The PIR sensor output crosses a predetermined threshold when human or animal presence is observed in the sensor zone. The threshold level-based hypothesis is used to apply the discrete action in controlling appliances. However, the analog output from the PIR sensor provides valuable insight into the underlying observations - movement direction, approximate distance from the sensor, fast/slow walking, and falling pattern can be estimated. Machine learning algorithms can be used to estimate parameters of interest with reasonable accuracy. In this paper, the direction of movement and distance of travel in the vicinity of the PIR sensing zone is estimated by commonly used ML algorithms. The paper depicts a unique 3D printed in-house developed wireless motion sensor node that eventually is used to create a sensor network. A group of engineering technology students designed a PIR sensor module, 3D printed housing structure and deployed it throughout the building hallway. They obtained raw data involving typical human motion from the sensor to further process it in the ML domain. This project was a part of the final year capstone design experience of a group.

articleTitle: A penalty based heuristic algorithm for solving bi-objective fire station location problem
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This paper deals with problem of allocating and determining the count of places within collection of prospective fire station locations in order to group the regions surrounding them while attaining two objectives ie. minimization of cost and duration with respect to given constraints. One constraint is to assign a unique site for every area that has been deliberately chosen for the purpose of setting one up and became the possible location whereon the allocation has to made. It is also agreed on the maximum areas that may be correspond to different fire stations. The two aim functions are to minimize the overall operating cost as well as the time required to cover the regions covered by the fire stations that have been selected. The proposed penalty based heuristic approach is utilised to determine a group of efficient solutions with respect to constraints. This can be a good alternative for decision makers for making facilities allocation related decisions.

articleTitle: Improved Smart Forecasting Model to Combat Coronavirus using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Coronavirus (COVID) is one of the world's most devastating diseases, affecting the lives of millions of people around the globe. Accurate and timely detection of the COVID virus is critical for human survival. The standard medical history of diagnosing COVID disease has been deemed unreliable in several ways. Noninvasive methods such as Machine Learning (ML) are efficient and reliable for classifying healthy persons and people with COVID disease. In this paper, we improved a Smart Forecasting Model using Machine Learning (SFML) for COVID prediction (positive, negative) by using COVID data. We applied, two algorithms of feature selection (correlation and gain ratio), two supervised ML algorithms (Random forest and support vector machine) and the technique of cross-validation was applied for evaluating the SFML, such as specificity, accuracy, F-measure, sensitivity, and running time. The proposed SFML may easily distinguish COVID infected individuals from healthy individuals. The proposed SFML has been tested on a full set of COVID features as well as a smaller set of features. The results reveal that reducing COVID features has an impact on SMFL performance measures.

articleTitle: Health risk detection through web app using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Health is one of the important aspect in the human life and without proper health the functioning of the human body is very tough, and it can't be the case that every time the health of a particular human being stays normal and there are no diseases found. Diseases are one of the biggest problems that the human needs to fight from as they come unannounced, and they might be at the initial stage, or they might by highly chronic depending on various factors. Some of the factors that might be the reason for which the disease can occur are bad habits like smoking, overeating, not exercising, daily life habits and others could be genetic diseases which are transferred through genes from the parents into the child which is one a maj or factors for the disease to arrive. There are many major diseases such as heart attack, diabetes, cancer and many more. The solution to these issues is to find a proper method to detect these diseases at a very early stage due to which this could be avoided or can be stopped and create a great impact. the issues that are there are just resolved using the artificial intelligence techniques, but it's really tough for the people to use it. The main motive of this paper is to help the general people who are unaware of the technologies and can easily use it through the web app present online which has all the features to detect the disease at an early stage.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Fuzzy Logic Controller for the PV battery system
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this paper adaptive back stepping fuzzy logic controller is designed to extract the maximum power for PV panel and to get the desired grid voltage for the battery in the PV battery system in order to get the enhanced transient and steady state responses. The control law is designed based on the back stepping procedure in which the asymptotically stable system is achieved by using Lyapunov Control function. In the proposed controller fuzzy logic is employed to approxmate the uncertainties caused by the irradiance and temperature which estimate the varying solar current. Simulations are done for the wide range of variations in the grid voltage and irradiance for the proposed controller. To ensure the robustness of the proposed controller it is compared with the convention PID controller. Based on the results the proposed controller shows the enriched transient and steady state responses with better settling time and minimum overshoot.

articleTitle: A Review of the Integration of Connectivity and System Integrity Approaches Using Internet of Things (IOT) for Enhancing Network Security
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The development of new digital technologies like Deep learning, Internet of things and others support in enhancing the industrial application, support the management in collecting, analysing, processing and storing large volume of data in an effective manner. Also, these technologies support in storing the information which can be retrieved in future. However, this possesses significant threat to the organisation in safeguarding the data and information support in enhancing network security effectively. It has been noted that IoT can enable in protecting the organisation from different cyber hacks and hence require different techniques to enhance the security level. Also, the wider application of IoT results in better communication and coordination among various systems and process in the business enterprises. This study is focused in understanding the key determinants related to the integration of the connectivity and system integrity approaches using IoT for enhancing the network security. The paper classified in understating the critical aspect which the organisation needs to focus in using IoT for enhancing security and protect the data and information, the researchers uses both primary and secondary data source for performing the study, furthermore it is noted that all the determinants of IoT supports in enhancing the network security in the organisation

articleTitle: Applications of AI: Software Verifiability Point of View
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)

articleTitle: Scope of Embedding Supervised learning Techniques on Sensors data in Sports Equipments
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Nowadays, almost every Athlete and people who are health-conscious monitor the physical variables of their bodies for various purposes like athletes to enhance their performance and normal people to remain fit. Sensor innovations aid individuals to follow, assess, and examine information while performing regular exercises like running, swimming, fencing, tennis and so on. This paper describes Various applications of Sensors in Sports including exercise games like golf simulation for Arthritis patients, Analysis of jump shoot motion in Basketball and for visually impaired Person- Archery Sight-System, Analysis of Swing in sports, Particularly Tennis swing motion, Measuring Vertical jump.

articleTitle: Violence Detection in Real Life Videos using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Detecting violence in video recordings through artificial intelligence is critical. Just because violence detection seems complex now, it doesn't mean that the problem should be ignored. With this paper, we aimed to show how we can do violence detection and how it can be implemented easily with the simplest methods at hand thanks to the progressing advances in deep learning and AI. Furthermore, it could be an excellent tool for preventing children from accessing inappropriate content and assisting guardians in making better decisions about what their children should watch. This is a challenging topic since the definition of violence is broad and quite abstract. As a result, recognizing such intricacies from recordings without human intervention is not just a technical issue, but also a theoretical one. In light of this, using a convolutional neural network, we will investigate how to depict the concept of violence. For image categorization, there are numerous pre-trained convolutional neural networks available. These models have figured out how to bring out dynamic and useful highlights from regular pictures and use them as a beginning stage to get familiar with new tasks. These networks can classify images into various object categories after being trained on over a million photos. We used pre-trained networks with transfer learning since it's regularly much quicker and more straightforward than preparing or training a network from scratch. Using several deep learning techniques, we will investigate which model will provide the best accuracy for recognizing violence in videos for this project.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation on impacts of insulation damage fault between laminations of power transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Power systems require transformers, as their most strategically important and most costly elements. When the insulation separating laminations of power transformers breaks down, can cause severe failures in large transformers and causes accidental outage which can be costly to remedy and leads to financial lost. This study examines the impacts of interlaminar insulation damage for laminations of power transformers for various flux densities and set points. The experimental work for the study involves inducing degradation of inter-lamination for various locations and for various lamination numbers of 2, 6, and 12 laminations. A flux density of 0.5T, 1.0T, 1.5T, 1,7T and 1.8T.was required for satisfactory outcomes. From the study findings, when inter-lamination insulation breaks down, this significantly affects the cores' magnetic properties. As shorted lamination numbers increase, the temperatures and the power loss increase significantly.

articleTitle: Face Age Estimation: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Over the year's researchers have been attempting to evolve ways for the computers to discern and acknowledge the visual data. Age Estimation became a pivotal field in the Computer Vision and has gained enormous acclamation owing to its scores of applications. Many researches and study have been devoted in the field of estimation of age but still there is a significant gap to fill in. This paper highlights a comprehensive review of the previous works in the domain of Face Age Estimation.

articleTitle: Design A Wireless Network Data Security System for Medical Records Using Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The introductory section of the research mainly deals with the benefits of using a data security system for keeping all medical records safe and secure. However, the medical authorities need to implement an effective data security management system by using IoT and a wireless networking system for data management. All the essential benefits, as well as the importance of using a data security management system, is necessary for keeping all the records related to medical facilities safe and secure. The literature review section of the research mainly discusses all the benefits of using a data security management system for medical records safety. However, the entire essential benefits, as well as technologies, needs to be focused on managing all the data security systems. All the necessary details for keeping medical data safe and secure is important for accessing all the patients' information from an effective perspective. However, designing this data security management is important for keeping all medical records safe and secure. In the data analysis part two tests have been occurred one is regression test and another is one sample T test where two independent variable are chosen and those are year and use of cryptography in health sectors. The dependent variable is enhanced level of protection of medical records. The derived values have been compared with. 05 that is the level of significance.

articleTitle: Model Order Reduction using Routh Approximation and Pade Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel reduction technique for higher-order systems. By using the suggested hybrid approach, the lower-order system is achieved. In this proposed work, the denominator polynomial of the reduced order system is identified using the Routh approximation technique, and the numerator polynomial of the reduced order system is determined using the Pade method. The proposed approach is theoretically straightforward and always creates a stable reduced system for stable the original systems. The performance of the anticipated technique is examined through various numerical illustrations.

articleTitle: An Assessment of bio-fuel potential in fulfilling the energy requirements of cold storage in India
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Every year in India, over 18% of fruits and vegetables are wasted due to lack of cold storage. A food agency of the United Nations said that 40% of fruits and vegetables in India become unhealthy before reaching the people. There is a severe shortage of cold storage in India, while India is the second largest producer of fruits and vegetables in the world, as well as being an agricultural based country. In order to overcome the above losses, effective post-harvest storage infrastructure is required. Since cold storage is a power gulping monster and in order to develop the infrastructure for the same, large electric requirements needs to be addressed. It can be met by the conventional electricity production, but it will further increase our dependence on crude oil imports or it will have an impact on environment. By looking into the above scenario two different sustainable approaches are proposed. One of the approaches is of integrated vapor absorption system driven by bio-fuel based combustion chamber. Another approach is to run vapor absorption system on the waste heat rejected by the internal combustion (IC) engines powered by bio-fuels. Coefficient of performance (COP) based analysis has been done to determine the yearly requirements of different bio-fuels for meeting this requirement. On the basis of result obtained biodiesel is proposed for first model and biogas & ethanol is proposed for second system.

articleTitle: A review about Zig Zag and Double Zig Zag connections in Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Whenever we think of three-phase transformer connections, we think straightaway of either star-connected transformers or delta-connected transformers. A great majority of polyphase transformers are either in series or connected in delta. In either case, the connection is symmetrical or balanced. In this paper, the winding connections, the voltage distribution in the windings, the application of zig-zag connections, and the testing of zig-zag transformers are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Effective Battery Cooling System for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: To estimate and assess the impact of temperature on battery performance parameters, we constructed a battery model using MATLAB 2021 and Simscape. We used a given electric car model in MATLAB to investigate the effect of temperature on battery life cycle. The influence of temperature on the battery pack is our main emphasis. The battery utilized in this project is a Lithium-ion battery, which is widely used in electric vehicles. The battery's specifications are also provided in this. For constructing our effective battery pack, we also go over the battery management system and the battery thermal management system. We will investigate the influence of battery temperature while the automobile is in motion, as well as after attaching a cooling system to the battery. We'll also talk about the impact of temperature on battery internal resistance, and how this increased internal resistance or temperature causes a sudden spike in battery voltage.

articleTitle: A Critical Review Analysis of the Opportunities and Potential of Implementing Cloud Computing System for Large Scale Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The increase in the usage of various computing and mobile devices has resulted in implementing large scale ad hoc networks as the user demand is on the rise and companies' find it difficult to invest more in the IT infrastructure to meet the surging demand. The traditional model of networking enables the mobile devices to face various issues like lower bandwidth, mobility, security and storage et. Hence, in order to meet the overall service requirement and to enhance the overall efficiency of the network, cloud computing was introduced. The implementation of these devices tends to support in every node, it enhances better communication in a better range towards another nodes. There is a critical administration and support devices from everywhere in an effective manner. Hence the new paradigm of implementing cloud computing support the computing and medical devices in the neighbouring network. The ad hoc network supports in covering larger area base and hence cloud computing supports them in enhancing the effectiveness of operations. This study covers in addressing the critical determinants of analysing the overall opportunities and potential in implementing cloud computing for ad hoc networks. The major factors considered are enhancing the processing capabilities using cloud computing, scalability of network and autonomous and independent networking support. These aspects promote enhanced ad hoc networking for enhancing communication between the devices, enable the organisation to spend less on the IT infrastructure

Author Keywords: Opportunities and Potential in Cloud computing

articleTitle: A Review on light Illumination and evocation techniques in OLEDs
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Asymmetry in the organic substance produces a discrepancy in light extraction and distribution spectra in OLEDs. We've selected a variety of strategies that can be employed as optical functionals to improve emission and modify spectral distribution. To circumvent this limitation, techniques such as capping layer, microlens, diffusers, and IMI are used. Finally, we have offered a realistic guideline for designing high-performance OLEDs.

articleTitle: A novel method of Image Segmentation-Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this paper, we present the methods of abstracting separation of satellite imagery; we used seven techniques at this s, Kiresh method, Laplacian technique, Canny strategies, Robert's strategies, and Edge Maximization Technique (EMT) is also compared to another to choose the best way to get the edge section image. These techniques are used on a single satellite image to select the backstage; Sobel operator technique, Prewitt techniques guess the partition or edge adoption image. We propose a novel multi-scale acquisition edge and a vector field design plan. We show that the use of multiscale techniques to obtain the edge and quality of separation in natural images can be greatly improved. Our approach eliminates the need to choose a clear scale and follow the edge. Our approach prefers existing edges over a wide range of scales and makes these edges geographically with the best scales. This work is then extended to separate images by multiple scales using our anisotropic distribution system.

Author Keywords: non-continuity adoption / Types of discontinuation acquisition

articleTitle: A Review: Study About Techniques to Improve Quality of Services And Security in Manets
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Remote correspondence innovations are assuming a critical part in the plan and execution of Mobile Ad hoc Network (MANET). The portrayal of MANET, for example, dynamism in geography, restricted transfer speed and power usage expands the unlicensed correspondence advancements and intricacies in existing conventions. This paper analyzes the current and not so distant future Wireless correspondence Technologies in the 2.4 GHz band. Additionally, this paper thinks about the features and limits of those advances lastly closes with the need for the improvement of reasonable brought together convention for existing and future remote advances. It has been considered that the overview and correlation introduced in this paper would help specialists and application engineers in choosing a fitting innovation for MANET administrations.

articleTitle: A Multiple Regression Analysis Approach to Understand the Critical Factors Impacting the Application of Machine Learning Techniques for Effective Productivity
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In the global business environment, organisations in the financial and banking industry need to be recruit and retain talents who are more creative, involve themselves in the job and enable in supporting the organisation to achieve the mission and vision. It has been regarded that the application of AI support in enhancing the productivity and thereby result in sustainable development. The current economic situations calls for using sophisticated technologies for enhancing the output and meet the needs of the stakeholders. Hence, the study is focused more in understanding the role of AI in enhancing the productivity in the organisation. Business managers focuses in considering the human capital who take more initiative, appreciate changes and stimulate more innovation in servicing the customers effectively. So as to meet the growing needs of the customers, companies in the services industry like banks, financial institutions etc tend to remove their centralised control management so as to enhance flexibility, deliver better services and make the employed be involved in the job effectively. It's been stated that job involvement is considered as the key factor which contributes immensely in increasing efficiency of the employees and achieve greater performance A higher the level of job involvement of the individuals in the organisation, better is their level of efficiency. Business enterprises in the banking domain is increasing the level of job involvement through various aspects like motivation, job analysis, performance appraisal, career management, effective financial and non-financial compensation and other measures. These aspects are focused to increase the performance of the employee and thereby increasing organisational performance. Hence the organisation implements different aspects to increase the job involvement of the employees in the organisation. This paper is focused in understanding the key factors which are influencing the job involvement of private banking companies, the researchers intend to apply multiple regression analysis so as to analyse the key variables which possess greater influence on the job involvement in the selected organisation. For the purpose of this analysis nearly 6 banking companies are selected with an acquired sample of 225 valid cases

articleTitle: Review of Methods of EEG Signal Classification Based Computer Brain Interface Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Since the beginning of the previous decade, advances in brain science and computer technology have propelled this field to the top of the applied science research priority list, where it is expected to remain for the foreseeable future. In applied science, the brain-computer interface (BCI) is one of the emerging research projects because it has a broad application area. Fortunately, with the resurgence of BCI, new avenues of neurorehabilitation are becoming accessible to those who are physically challenged as well as those who have had brain injuries. A few examples of technological advancements have piqued the attention of academics working on BCI techniques. Thorough knowledge of the many experimental paradigms that are works in EEG-based BCI systems is thus essential. Aside from that, the most suitable BCI software must be picked due to a large number of accessible possibilities. This will allow a prosthesis or neurorehabilitation device to be handled efficiently to get the best potential results. The present study assesses EEG-based BCItechniques in terms of their benefits and limitations, considering a range of perspectives, including those of the author. It is necessary to compare the performance of several EEG decoding algorithms and classification strategies to identify which is most effective in each paradigm. It is possible to get an overview of the applications of many paradigms with particular patients by reading this text. In this paper, a review of various previous techniques proposed to perform BCI using EEG signal processing is discussed.

articleTitle: Review of ML techniques for analyzing Novel Corona Virus
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Currently, the demand of machine learning is increasing in healthcare field for disease diagnosis. The various kinds of machine learning algorithms are helping the medical field for prognosis of diseases with accuracy and therefore serving the humankind in timely classification and detection of diseases. This study emphasizes on using different machine learning techniques for analysis of Covid-19 disease prediction. This paper presents the review of several machine learning classifiers such as SVM, Ensemble learning, Multilayered Perceptron, Naive Bayes, KNN and ANN, and analyze their classification accuracies in Novel Corona Virus prediction. The authorized datasets have been considered to perform this analysis. This analysis may serve as good indicator for analysts and medical professionals in selection of efficient classifier for the datasets that may save the time and prediction cost.
